anglia-ruskin-university-college-aruc.name: Anglia Ruskin University College (ARUC)
anglia-ruskin-university-college-aruc.about:
Anglia Ruskin University's story begins in 1858 when the art critic, patron, and philanthropist John Ruskin opened the Cambridge Art School. Cambridge is internationally renowned as a centre of learning. ARU has been in Cambridge since 1858, when the Cambridge School of Art first opened its doors. The friendly, bustling campus is a five minute walk from the historic city centre with its vibrant cultural and social scene.
ARU College offers undergraduate and postgraduate pathways for applicants that do not meet the requirements for direct entry, have not studied the subjects required for the chosen degree, or spent some time out of education. Following completion of the ARU College pathway, students will benefit from direct entry onto an ARU degree.
Why Anglia Ruskin University College - Cambridge:
Location: Cambridge is a creative city, home to well-known music venues and clubs, including the Corn Exchange and Cambridge Junction. It is also home to the Cambridge Arts Theatre and ADC Theatre, Britain's oldest University playhouse. Cambridge is home to famous streets, museums, intriguing shops, markets, galleries, and bookshops - the opportunities are endless in this 21st century city!
Facilities: In the last five years, ARU has invested over £80 million in campus developments, with a further £124 million planned over the next five years. Specialist facilities include a suite of forensic science laboratories, 4 university libraries, a university eye clinic, 2 art galleries, and mock courtrooms, hospital wards, and operating theatres.
Emphasis on internationalisation: One in five students at ARU is from outside the UK, creating a diverse student body population and allowing for students of all backgrounds to feel welcome.

aston-university-oncampus-centre.name: Aston University ONCAMPUS Centre
aston-university-oncampus-centre.about:
ONCAMPUS Aston is based on the campus of Aston University located in the city of Birmingham. As a top 30 UK university, Aston was the pioneer of the placement year and is renowned for its focus on employability and entrepreneurship.
Aston has been named as University of the Year 2020 (The Guardian) and awarded Outstanding Entrepreneurial University 2020 (Times Higher Education). Aston Business School has also been ranked in the top 100 European Business Schools by the Financial Times in 2020.
Students who study at ONCAMPUS Aston are guaranteed progression to Aston University following the successful completion of a Foundation Programme.
Why Aston University - ONCAMPUS:
Internationally Recognized: Aston University was awarded University of the Year by The Guardian (2020), Outstanding Entrepreneurial University by Times Higher Education (2020), and awarded the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) Gold for Teaching Excellence.
Location: Aston University is located in Birmingham, a diverse, multi-cultural hub for business and industry that has been recognized as the most diverse entrepreneurial region by Start-up Britain. Birmingham is also located less than 90 minutes from London and Manchester and has great links to Europe with the airport located just a 10 minute train ride from the city.
Facilities and Campus Life: Aston offers a wide range of sports and fitness facilities, including a 25m swimming pool, a state of the art gym, sports halls, grass pitches, and all-weather pitches. The school also offers over 130 student-led groups, meaning there is something to appeal to any and all interests!
Guaranteed Progression: Students who study at ONCAMPUS Aston are guaranteed progression to Aston University upon successful completion of a Foundation Programme.

asu-london-kaplan.name: ASU London (Kaplan)
asu-london-kaplan.about:
ASU London, offers in-demand degrees in Business, Computing and Engineering, all powered by innovation, technology and AI, and taught through project-based learning.
Globally focused, socially aware and from diverse backgrounds, the engineers of the future will work together to solve problems and improve lives. ASU London has been created to educate and inspire these engineers. ASU London offers a project-based approach to learning. Students work on real-life industry challenges, co-designed and delivered with employers. And instead of traditional lecture theatres, students learn in creative, practical Makerspaces. ASU London’s approach to teaching is what really sets it apart. One will not find any lecture halls here, as learning is practical and interactive. The project-based curriculum is designed to get students job ready - in fact, at ASU London learners won’t be considered a student, but a ‘Professional in Training’. Many members of teaching staff also hold positions in industry, and learners will work on projects for big-name employers too, so they will learn the skills they need to succeed in the Engineering industry.
ASU London has partnered with Kaplan International Pathways to offer direct admission to undergraduate Business, Computing and Engineering degrees. Their combined aim is to create engineers of the future with industry-relevant skills, and to make Engineering accessible to all by challenging stereotypes of what it takes to be a great engineer.
Why ASU London (in partnership with Kaplan International)
Specialist facilities: At ASU London’s campus in Canada Water, students will benefit from exceptional facilities, from small prototyping and 3D printing to large-scale equipment and teaching rooms.

bangor-university-international-college-.name: Bangor University International College (BUIC)
bangor-university-international-college-.about:
Bangor University International College (BUIC) is a specialist Embedded College offering Incorporated Programmes, where international students can begin their studies at Bangor University. BUIC delivers the first stages of the International Incorporated Bachelors Degree, International Year One, and the International Incorporated Masters. Whilst Oxford International holds responsibility for the academic provision, all quality assurance and maintenance of quality standards for all teaching at the Bangor University International College remains strictly with Bangor University.
Student's time at Bangor University International College is part of their degree. Following successful completion of Stage 1 BUIC, students will continue their studies directly with Bangor University. This means by attending the college, students can complete their degree in four years at the undergraduate level, or two years at postgraduate level.
Why Bangor University International College:
Small Class Sizes: Smaller class sizes mean that students will receive ample individual support and attention from their tutors as they acquire knowledge and understanding of core subjects.
Diverse Academic Community: BUIC hosts students from all over the world, so students will have the opportunity to learn about different cultures, broaden their horizons, and make life-long friendships.
Location: Students can live in one of the most scenic locations in the UK as they study. Nestled between the mountains and the sea, Bangor is more than just beautiful: it's a playground for nature lovers.

birmingham-city-university-international.name: Birmingham City University International College (BCUIC)
birmingham-city-university-international.about:
Birmingham City University International College (BCUIC) offers students an entry point to a wide range undergraduate and postgraduate degrees, many of which include opportunities for work placements. Students receive academic and language training and support that will prepare them for success in their progression degree. Pathway subjects include: Architecture, Art & Design, Business, Engineering, Fashion, Media, Sport Management and more!
BCUIC is located in the heart of Birmingham, right next to the university's City Centre campus and offers several accommodation options that are only a few minutes' walk from the campus. Once enrolled at BCUIC, students also gain full access to the university's facilities.
Why University of Plymouth International College
Campus: Birmingham City University comprises three main campuses, with additional sites located throughout the city - including one of the largest jewelry schools in the world.
Facilities: Students can find the latest in spaces, equipment, and technology that will support their learning, such as the £8.5 million sports center, with an 80-station fitness suite and 8-court sports hall, new specialist laboratories for Health and Life Sciences, the CITY trading room which uses the same investment analysis software as traders and financial analysts, and more!
Location: Located right in the center of the UK, Birmingham is the country's second-largest city, with under 25s accounting for nearly 40% of its population - an ideal destination for students! Also, rent prices in Birmingham are more than 50% lower than in London, making it a more affordable place to live, study, and explore.

bournemouth-university-international-col.name: Bournemouth University International College
bournemouth-university-international-col.about:
Bournemouth University International College offers pathway courses and Pre-Sessional English programmes in partnership with Bournemouth University, and is located on the University campus. The College is the ideal setting for degree preparation. Students will benefit from state-of-the-art facilities and expert teaching, as well as comfortable accommodation attached to the College building as students start their path degree success. Bournemouth University is creative, enterprising and international. Located on England’s beautiful south coast, it has state-of-the-art facilities that help students get the most from their studies. 39 nationalities were represented by new students at the College in 2020.
Bournemouth University International College has 3 main types of pathway course: Foundation Certificate, International Year One and Pre-Master’s. The College also offers Pre-Sessional English courses if students already meet BU’s academic entry requirements.
Why Bournemouth University International College (Kaplan International Pathways)
Location: Bournemouth is a seaside town with 11km of sandy beaches and beautiful surrounding countryside. The College's convenient location is ideal for shopping and socializing with friends, playing outdoor sports, and visiting local attractions.
Staff Support: Bournemouth's friendly staff help students with every aspect of student life, both inside and outside the classroom, and organize many different activities, events and trips for students to enjoy.
Outstanding Accommodation: The College building gives students the ideal study abroad experience. As well as excellent learning and social facilities, the College has its own student residence on the upper floors, with stylish, modern apartments offering privacy and comfort.

brunel-university-london-pathway-college.name: Brunel University London Pathway College
brunel-university-london-pathway-college.about:
Brunel University London Pathway College is designed to meet the needs of students by offering world-class pathway programs leading to undergraduate and postgraduate degrees at Brunel University London. At undergraduate level, this pathway college offers University Foundation and First year University Studies for candidates who do not meet the direct entry criteria or hold high school qualifications that are not recognized. At postgraduate level, Brunel University London Pathway College provides the highly acclaimed Pre-Master's program leading to an excellent range of Brunel University London Master programs in business and management, computing, engineering & design and arts.
Brunel University London Pathway College is located inside Brunel University London Campus, so students will experience university student life from day one. and they will have access to all of university facilities. Brunel University London Pathway College is there to support students for their future academic and professional careers. Brunel is a single site university where students can take part in a diverse range of clubs and societies for an action-packed social life. Everything is within a 10-minute walk - whether students are going to a class or for a coffee, whether they want a place to eat or a space to meet, it's all close by!
Why Brunel University London Pathway College?
Facilities and Safety: Located inside Brunel University London. Students are offered a safe, friendly and positive environment where they benefit from high-quality teaching, recreation and sporting facilities.
Location: Campus is well-connected. Just a short walk away, the town of Uxbridge offers students everything they need to shop, entertain and socialize, with central London just a tube ride away.

cardiff-university-international-study-c.name: Cardiff University International Study Centre
cardiff-university-international-study-c.about:
Students can build confidence in their language skills and subject knowledge as they explore all that Cardiff - and Wales - has to offer. To get to Cardiff University, students can choose Cardiff University International Study Centre to help them prepare to start their degree at a prestigious Russell Group university.
The programs are designed in conjunction with Cardiff University. They are delivered by Study Group, a global leader in preparing international students for academic success which has 25 years of experience in international education. Students will study their pathway programme in a friendly and supportive environment, surrounded by other international students. The study centre offers international foundation and pre-master's pathways in a variety of subjects.
Why Cardiff University International Study Centre
Campus life: Cardiff University is a respected Russell Group university with a proud history of celebrating difference. Its research is making an impact around the world, and leading academics share their findings with students in the classroom. Join the community at Cardiff University International Study Centre and study in the centre of a UK capital city, on the University campus. Cardiff is a vibrant, affordable modern city with a multicultural history.
Enhanced teaching environment: Experienced staff are always available to help students with anything they need, both inside and outside of their academic studies. The centre's programmes are designed and tailored for international students to familiarize them with the teaching style at Cardiff University.
Hands-on experience: The University's wide range of industry links informs courses and helps students develop the tools necessary to find and succeed in employment.

durham-university-international-study-ce.name: Durham University International Study Centre
durham-university-international-study-ce.about:
Durham University International Study Centre is the first step to gaining a degree from a world-leading university that is one of the oldest in the UK. You will take your first steps in the UK towards a degree at Durham University at a dedicated centre for international students located on Queen's Campus in Stockton. The campus is small and welcoming with everything you need close by.
Why the Durham University International Study Centre
Highly ranked: Durham University is a member of the prestigious Russell Group of universities. It consistently ranks as one of the top 100 universities in the world by the Times Higher Education World University Rankings and the QS World University Rankings include a world top 100 university - 78th in QS World University Rankings 2020, ranked 7th in the UK - The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2020, 90% of subjects ranked in the UK top 10 and two subjects ranked number one (English and Music) - Complete University Guide 2020, 18 subjects ranked in the world top 100 and 10 subjects ranked in the world top 50 - QS World University Rankings by Subject 2019.
Support every step of the way: You will receive a high level of support and will find it easier to settle into UK life. We will help you throughout the admissions process by providing expert guidance and support. After completing your studies here, you will have the confidence, skills and academic knowledge to study a degree at Durham University.
Access to world-renowned facilities and staff: Students have access to research-led education delivered by world-leading experts in outstanding study facilities. This approach to education ensures that the courses are up-to-date with current developments.

glasgow-international-college.name: Glasgow International College
glasgow-international-college.about:
The University of Glasgow is the 4th-oldest university in the English speaking world and it has been shaping the minds of bright and ambitious students for more than 550 years. It is a place where the past meets the present in truly exciting ways and attending the University of Glasgow means becoming a member of an academic community with a long history of teaching and research excellence. Follow the footsteps of alumni who have changed the world, including 7 Nobel laureates and 3 British Prime Ministers.
In partnership with the University of Glasgow, the University of Glasgow International College offers a wide selection of pathway programs at undergraduate and postgraduate levels for students who require additional preparation for a degree program. Pathway programs are delivered right on campus and students get to build their academic and English skills with other international students in group classes and through one-on-one tutoring. Upon successful completion of the pathway program, students are guaranteed progression to a degree program and are well-equipped to continue with their studies.
Why Glasgow International College (at the University of Glasgow) (Kaplan International Pathways)
Campus: The university's diverse community is made up of students and faculty from over 140 countries. There are more than 150 clubs, societies, and sports teams for students to make new friends with shared interests and hobbies.
Facilities: Students in pathway programs not only get to walk through a campus with stunning architecture that dates back hundreds of years, but they also are issued university students cards that grant them access to the university's modern resources which include Europe's largest library and a state-of-the-art gym.

hertfordshire-international-college-hic.name: Hertfordshire International College (HIC)
hertfordshire-international-college-hic.about:
Hertfordshire International College (HIC) offers students a modern and dynamic educational experience to study at a modern, business-facing University. They are committed to providing educational pathways and support services in an environment that encourages students to achieve excellence in their studies.
By choosing to study with HIC, students will have access to a wide range of courses and an exciting choice of modules - all designed to prepare them for progression to their chosen degree. Located on the vibrant and modern University of Hertfordshire campus which is located in the center of Hatfield, HIC provides students with the opportunity to make friends with other students from a variety of backgrounds and cultures.
Why University of Hertfordshire International College?
Location: HIC is centrally located, only 25 minutes from London by train
Safe: 2nd Safest University Town in the East of England (Complete University Guide - Crime Statistics - England and Wales, 2017)
Academics: One of the world's top 150 universities under 50 years old (Times Higher Education, THE, Young Universities Rankings 2018)
Employability: Top 10 University for graduate employment (Times Higher Education, THE, 2016). Over 96,5% of graduates in employment or further study six months after graduation (Destination of Leavers From Higher Education 2016/17)
Community: Among the top 20% of the world's most international Universities (Times Higher Education, THE, 2016)

international-college-at-robert-gordon-u.name: International College at Robert Gordon University (ICRGU)
international-college-at-robert-gordon-u.about:
Robert Gordon University (RGU) delivers a high quality vocational education and relevant curriculum which provides learners with the skills they require to thrive throughout their careers. As a result, the university has a reputation for producing graduates that are highly sought after by employers. Over the last decade RGU has consistently had one of the best records of any UK university for graduate level employment. Its reputation for teaching excellence is demonstrated further through its Gold Rating in the UK Teaching Excellence Framework. It celebrates a high quality student experience and is currently ranked in the top three universities in Scotland for student satisfaction. It has been named as the Scottish University of the Year in The Times & Sunday Times Good University Guide, 2021.
RGU has a heritage going back 250 years and was awarded university status in 1992. Throughout its development, the university has remained committed to creating equal opportunities to access a relevant and valuable education. It is made up of eleven schools and offers over 300 courses ranging from engineering, architecture, computing, and life sciences to the creative industries, health and social care, and business. It has a student population of over 16,500, who study on-campus and online; notably, it is one of the largest providers of distance learning in the UK. Courses are developed through close collaboration with employers, professions and industry to address skills regional and national needs, and this ensures that curriculum is demand-led.

international-college-portsmouth-icp.name: International College Portsmouth (ICP)
international-college-portsmouth-icp.about:
Studying at International College of Portsmouth and then the University of Portsmouth is going to be one of the most exciting times of a student's life. A degree from the University of Portsmouth will offer students the best learning experience and industry exposure. Students can choose from a range of pathway programs designed to prepare them for the next step in their studies.
ICP is an Associate College of the University of Portsmouth founded in 2009. ICP is a member of the global Navitas Group, a respected leader in global higher education partnered with more than 120 colleges and campuses worldwide. ICP provides multiple pathways to a broad range of degrees, in an environment that encourages students to achieve their best in all aspects of the university journey.
Why International College Portsmouth (ICP)
Location: Only 90 minutes from central London by train, Portsmouth is one of the sunniest cities in the country. ICP is in the heart of Portsmouth so students are never too far away from the city centre, or even the beautiful beaches along the south coast of England. It is a campus based college part of the University of Portsmouth city centre campus, just a five-minute walk from the main railway station (Portsmouth & Southsea) and within easy reach of the beach.
Excellence: The University of Portsmouth is a winner of the prestigious 'Gold' rating in the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) - one of only four Gold-rated universities in the south east.
Success: Over 4,000 ICP students have progressed to the University of Portsmouth since 2009.

kaplan-international-college-london-city.name: Kaplan International College London: City, University of London
kaplan-international-college-london-city.about:
At Kaplan International College (KIC) London - City, University of London students can build their future by studying in the UK, with a pathway course. Situated in the world’s top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), the College will prepare students for a university degree, and for a successful career. Students are able to study at one of the most respected international colleges in London, and progress to their chosen degree at City, University of London.
City is a member institution of the University of London, one of the oldest and largest universities in the UK. Dedicated to providing an outstanding academic experience and award-winning support, City equips students with the tools they need to build a thriving and sustainable career. Located in the heart of London’s financial district, City is home to five specialist ‘Schools’ including The Business School (formerly Cass) - one of Europe’s leading business schools with a world-class reputation. Join an international community, with students coming from more than 160 different countries to study at City. From the diverse faith team to the Student Counselling and Mental Health service, there are a range of support facilities on offer to help all members of the City community.
Why Kaplan International College London: City, University of London
Dedicated Support: From extending visas to dealing with homesickness, College staff will be happy to help with any issues that students may face. Student’s will also benefit from frequent events arranged by the College so they can meet new friends and make the most of their time in London
Convenient Accommodation: Students are able to stay in comfortable, modern accommodation that is close to classes.

kaplan-international-college-london-cran.name: Kaplan International College London: Cranfield University
kaplan-international-college-london-cran.about:
Build a future by studying in the UK with a pathway course at Kaplan International College (KIC) London. Situated in the world's top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), the College will prepare students for a university degree and for a successful career.
Cranfield University is the UK's only exclusively postgraduate university in Technology and Management. Its advanced technology and state-of-the-art facilities will help students on the path to career success.
Why Cranfield University: Kaplan International College London
Postgraduate specialization and research: Cranfield is a six-time winner of the Queen's Anniversary Prize for Further and Higher Education. It is ranked in the top ten UK universities for commercial research, consultancy, and professional development. As an exclusively postgraduate university, Cranfield is excluded from the Times Higher Education World University Rankings, which focuses on helping prospective undergraduate students to compare universities.
Small class sizes: Cranfield's staff-to-student ratio is 8:1, one of the best of any university in the UK. Students will appreciate Cranfield's hands-on, practical approach, specialist focus, and the depth and excellence of the education they will receive.
Facilities: Built on a former RAF base, Cranfield is one of only a few universities in the world to own and run its own airport, maintaining an aerospace heritage spanning back more than 70 years. Many facilities are industry standard, used by other universities and serve as an essential, front-line resource for the UK as a whole. This includes the National Flying Laboratory Centre, the National Wind Tunnel facility, and the National Reference Centre for Soils.

kaplan-international-college-london-quee.name: Kaplan International College London: Queen Mary, University of London
kaplan-international-college-london-quee.about:
Students can build their futures by studying in the UK with a pathway course at Kaplan International College (KIC) London. Situated in the world's top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), KIC London is one of the most-respected international colleges in London. The College offers a wide selection of preparatory courses for students looking to pursue a university degree in the UK. Upon successful completion of a pathway program, students may progress to one of several universities, including the Queen Mary, University of London (Queen Mary).
Queen Mary is one of the UK’s leading research-focused higher education institutions. It is ranked 13th in the UK and 110th in the world (The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2021). A broad range of subjects are taught and researched at the university, including humanities, social sciences, law, medicine and dentistry, and science and engineering.
Queen Mary is home to England's first official medical school, which was founded in 1785. Since, then it has been a place where some of the brightest minds have studied and researched, with 9 staff and alumni having received Nobel prizes. It is one of the largest University of London colleges, with around 28,000 students - 35% of whom are international students from over 160 countries. In 2017, Queen Mary was voted one of the most internationally diverse schools in the world by Times Higher Education World University rankings.
Why Kaplan International College London: Queen Mary, University of London
Facilities: KIC London is located in Palace House, which offers students flexible study spaces, private huddle rooms, lots of areas for socializing, and high-speed WiFi throughout the building. Classrooms have been designed to enhance the student experience.

kaplan-international-college-london-univ.name: Kaplan International College London: University of Birmingham
kaplan-international-college-london-univ.about:
Students can build their futures by studying in the UK with a pathway course at Kaplan International College (KIC) London. Situated in the world's top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), KIC London is one of the most-respected international colleges in London. The College offers a wide selection of preparatory courses for students looking to pursue a university degree in the UK. Upon successful completion of a pathway program, students may progress to one of several universities, including the University of Birmingham.
University of Birmingham is home to one of the largest communities of international students in the UK, with over 10,000 students from more than 150 countries, giving students the chance to meet people from all around the world.
Why Kaplan International College: University of Birmingham
Facilities: KIC London is located in Palace House, which offers students flexible study spaces, private huddle rooms, lots of areas for socializing, and high-speed WiFi throughout the building. Classrooms have been designed to enhance the student experience.
Location: Voted the world's premier student city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), London offers students iconic venues, including entertainment, restaurants and bars, shopping, major tourist attractions and more. Just a short walk away from London Bridge station, KIC London is ideally located for exploring the city and all its attractions.
Guaranteed progression: Students are guaranteed entry to the university of their choosing when they pass their Kaplan International College London course at the required level with good attendance.
Convenient Accommodation: When students study at KIC London, they'll be able to stay in comfortable, modern accommodation that is easy to reach their classes from.

kaplan-international-college-london-univ.name: Kaplan International College London: University of Bristol
kaplan-international-college-london-univ.about:
Students can build their futures by studying in the UK with a pathway course at Kaplan International College (KIC) London. Situated in the world's top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), the College will prepare students for a university degree and for a successful career.
The University of Bristol is a highly ranked Russell Group university with a fantastic reputation. Students will join a global community of students from more than 150 countries and enjoy life in one of the UK's most exciting cities.
Why Kaplan International College London: University of Bristol
Guaranteed entry: Students who pass their pathway courses at the required level with good attendance at Kaplan International College London will be guaranteed entry to the Bristol program of their choice.
Global reputation: The University of Bristol is a world-class institution, and a Bristol degree will be impressive to future employers. At Bristol, students will be a part of an academic community with a reputation for producing high-achieving graduates.
International student community: With students from more than 150 countries around the world, students will enjoy a multicultural study experience at Bristol. Students will meet people from many corners of the globe and benefit from learning about diverse cultures and different perspectives.
Outstanding academic history: 13 Nobel Prize winners are linked to the University, so as a Bristol student, students will follow in the path of some of the greatest minds in the world.

kaplan-international-college-london-univ.name: Kaplan International College London: University of Westminster
kaplan-international-college-london-univ.about:
Students can build their futures by studying in the UK with a pathway course at Kaplan International College (KIC) London. Situated in the world's top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), the College will prepare students for a university degree and for a successful career.
The commercially well-connected University of Westminster is hugely international. Students can study alongside students from nearly 170 countries at the school.
Why Kaplan International College London: University of Westminster
Guaranteed entry: Students are guaranteed entry to the university of their choosing when they pass their Kaplan International College London course at the required level with good attendance.
Location: London was voted the world's premier student city by QS Best Student Cities in 2019. As a student of KIC, students will have easy access to famous attractions such as the Big Ben, the London Eye, Buckingham Palace, and the museums of South Kensington.
Teaching and research excellence: Westminster is known for world-leading research across a range of subjects. This expertise influences teaching effectiveness, for which Westminster is ranked top 25 nationally (Guardian University Guide 2019), so students will learn from true specialists.
Career opportunity: The University of Westminster's Career Development Centre gives students great opportunities to find the right job and enhance their employability. Students can also take advantage of Westminster's links with leading companies worldwide across many industries.

kaplan-international-college-london-univ.name: Kaplan International College London: University of York
kaplan-international-college-london-univ.about:
At Kaplan International College (KIC) London - University of York students can build their future by studying in the UK, with a pathway course. Situated in the world’s top academic city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), the College will prepare students for a university degree, and for a successful career. Students are able to study at one of the most respected international colleges in London, and progress to their chosen degree at the University of York.
The University of York is among the best universities in the UK. It offers students a beautiful campus with modern facilities, close to one of England’s most historic cities. By joining the University of York, students will be part of a truly inspiring academic community at a leading UK university. Research is a huge part of the University's appeal. This research informs all teaching at the University of York, which means students will receive an up-to-date and relevant education - a great advantage when students start their chosen career. As well as this, teachers will be experts in their field. In fact, teaching at York was awarded Gold in the Teaching Excellence Framework, so students will be learning from highly qualified academics who truly care about their education.
Why Kaplan International College London: University of York
Dedicated Support: From extending visas to dealing with homesickness, College staff will be happy to help with any issues that students may face. Student’s will also benefit from frequent events arranged by the College so they can meet new friends and make the most of their time in London
Convenient Accommodation: Students are able to stay in comfortable, modern accommodation that is close to classes.

keele-university-international-college.name: Keele University International College
keele-university-international-college.about:
Since its establishment in 1949, Keele University has established a worldwide reputation as a leading research university. Its globally renowned faculties, focus on sustainability, and beautiful campus are enjoyed by over 10,000 students from more than 120 countries. Keele University offers a wide variety of programs to provide students with an individualized learning experience, and they can contribute to the university’s groundbreaking research in global health, sustainability, and sociology.
The Keele University International College provides an entryway to Keele University’s undergraduate and graduate degrees. Students with a broad variety of academic backgrounds can utilize its comprehensive foundation, International Year One and pre-master’s programs to progress into the degree programs that suit their unique goals.
Location: Located in the centre of Keele University’s beautiful campus in Staffordshire, Keele University International College is surrounded by many study spaces, shops, and 600 acres of countryside. Students are just five miles away from Stoke-on-Trent, where they can view the city’s local pottery, artwork, and scenery.
Student Support: Keele University International College focuses on supporting all students in their academic journeys. The school’s Student Union also provides advice for traveling and accommodation, in addition to over 120 clubs and societies.
Facilities: Students at Keele University International College have access to an impressive range of learning resources, research laboratories, and study spaces.
Accommodation: Students at Keele University International College can find a home away from home in one of over 2800 bedrooms in the university’s on-campus residences.

kingston-university-london-international.name: Kingston University London International Study Centre
kingston-university-london-international.about:
The International Study Centre is the perfect introduction to studying in the UK, giving students extra support as they start their university journey. By studying in an immersive environment, students can improve their English language abilities whilst gaining the academic experience they need for university. The International Study Centre provides the knowledge and skills needed for international study at Kingston University, London. The International Study Centre programmes are provided in collaboration with Study Group.
Kingston University is much more than a place of education, it will prepare students for employment and life in the future. The University offers career-focused courses and excellent teaching, which makes it the perfect place for ambitious students with big plans in business. This is why it is proud to be ranked 2nd best university in the UK for graduate start-ups (Higher Education Statistics Agency figures, 2017).
Why Kingston University International Study Centre?
Location: The University is based in the beautiful riverside town of Kingston upon Thames. It is a safe, student-friendly town and just 25 minutes from the centre of London, the world capital for business, finance and culture.
Accommodation: Kingston has a range of high-quality halls in multiple central locations, all close to the university. There is a free bus service that runs between the halls of residence, International Study Centre and town centre, making getting around Kingston easy.
Facilities: International Study Centre students are welcome to use all the facilities from day one. The University invested £12 million to refurbish its studios.

liverpool-john-moores-university-interna.name: Liverpool John Moores University International Study Centre
liverpool-john-moores-university-interna.about:
Liverpool John Moores University (LJMU) has been helping students realize their dreams for nearly 200 years. Offering 250 degree courses across multiple disciplines, it is one of the largest, most dynamic and forward-thinking universities in the UK. Some of LJMU's highest-ranking programs include:
Hospitality, Leisure, Recreation and Tourism (#2 in The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2021)
Sport Science (#10 in The Times and The Sunday Times Good University Guide 2021)
General Engineering (#16 in The Complete University Guide 2021)
Forensic Science (#20 in The Complete University Guide 2021)
The Liverpool John Moores University International Study Centre helps students get the most from their learning and social life as they prepare to progress to university. During their studies, students will be encouraged to learn about various degree options available to them, meet tutors in the subjects that interest them, and talk to current students to learn from their experiences.
Why Liverpool John Moores University
Campus: LJMU is home to a community of 25,000 students from more than 100 countries and 2,500 staff. The university has over 100 clubs and societies covering a range of academic and cultural interests that students can join to meet people with similar interests and make new friends.
Facilities: LJMU facilities include state-of-the-art science, technology and engineering laboratories, a forensic scene-of-crime lab, a 360˚ ship simulator, a mock courtroom, clinical practice suites, broadcast-quality TV and radio studios, and much more. All are designed to replicate industry environments, so you gain experience relevant to your chosen career even before you graduate.

manchester-metropolitan-university-inter.name: Manchester Metropolitan University International College
manchester-metropolitan-university-inter.about:
Manchester Metropolitan University International College is a part of Manchester Metropolitan University, providing pathway courses to help international students get ready to study undergraduate and masters degrees. The curriculum complements the University’s teaching and commitment to high-quality learning and students can choose from courses at Foundation, International Year One or Pre-Masters levels.
Manchester Metropolitan University International College is a global student city, home to 100,000 students, including 27,000 international students (Complete University Guide). It is a great place for students to live with the city ranked as the top 30 student city in the world by QS Best Student Cities 2024. Students can fly straight to the city as Manchester Airport is a major international airport, with flights to over 200 destinations.
Why Manchester Metropolitan University International College
Student Support: Get support on student journey with MMUIC's Foundation, International Year One and Pre-Masters courses.
Student Opportunity: Guaranteed entry to Manchester Met degree courses when students meet the progression criteria for their course. The can then choose from over 90 progression degrees.
Student Scholarships: Generous scholarships is available for each academic year for students who are self-funded. If students are eligible, these scholarships will be automatically applied to their chosen course, with no need to submit a separate application. This ensures that students can focus on their studies while MMUIC takes care of the rest.
Location: Manchester is home to world-class sports. Sportcity features world-class stadiums, iconic venues, and a hub of athletic excellence.

nottingham-trent-international-college.name: Nottingham Trent International College
nottingham-trent-international-college.about:
Nottingham Trent International College (NTIC) offers pathway courses in partnership with Nottingham Trent University (NTU), and is integrated into the University campus. Students can prepare for their future with pathway courses from Nottingham Trent International College. With high-quality teaching, world-class facilities and exceptional support, students will have everything they need to follow their path to success at university and beyond. There are a number of course options available at NTIC, at both undergraduate and postgraduate level. Students can choose from Foundation Certificate, International Year One, and Pre-Master's programs.
Why Nottingham Trent International College (at Nottingham Trent University) (Kaplan International Pathways)
Campus Location: Nottingham is a friendly city with lots of students and plenty to do with friends. Students can visit historical attractions like Nottingham Castle, browse the high street and independent shops, or even explore the city's underground caves.
Community Living: Kaplan Living Nottingham is a modern residence where students can join a friendly student community. Students will be close to both the city center and their classes, and can choose between a private bedroom in a shared flat or their own studio apartment.
Supportive Staff: Students will receive support from trained College staff from the moment they arrive in the UK. They'll be on hand to advise students on any issues they have, as well as helping them settle in and make new friends by organizing fun social activities with their classmates.
International Community: As well as being a famously friendly city, Nottingham has two universities and a large international student community.

royal-holloway-university-of-london-inte.name: Royal Holloway, University of London International Study Centre
royal-holloway-university-of-london-inte.about:
Students that do not meet the academic requirements for direct entry to Royal Holloway are able to apply for Foundation, International Year One and Pre-master's programs at the Royal Holloway International Study Centre. A foundation program bridges the gap between a student's high school education and the first year of study at Royal Holloway, as well as providing an opportunity to develop English language skills. International Year One programs allow students to complete the first year of their undergraduate degree with additional support from the International Study Centre. The pre-masters programs allow students to develop their English and research skills prior to entering a taught masters at Royal Holloway.
Why Royal Holloway, University of London
Research excellence: 2014 - RHUL ranked within the top 25% of universities in the UK for research rated ‘world-leading’ or ‘internationally excellent'
Highly ranked: Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings 2020 - RHUL ranked in the top 300 universities in the world and 34th overall in the UK. In the category of ‘International Outlook’, RHUL ranked 21st in the UK. The Complete University Guide 2019 - RHUL ranked 23rd and in the Guardian University Guide 2018 - RHUL ranked 40th
Student Satisfaction: RHUL scored 88% in the National Student Survey (NSS) 2019, 4% above the national average and higher than 21 of the 22 Russell Group universities which appear in the survey.

solent-university-pathway-college.about:
Solent University Pathway College to deliver a range of programmes for foundation to undergraduate level. The International Foundation Programme pathway programmes are designed to help International students improve their academic and English language skills before undertaking undergraduate degree studies with Solent University.
Why Solent University
Campus Life: Solent University's Pathway College campus in Southampton, UK is in the heart of the city, close to a variety of bars, restaurants, shops, and other attractions. The campus is also within walking distance of the six halls of residence, which are close to each other and create a community feel.
Facilities: School offer a range of opportunities including a programme of essentials training for all staff, degree and higher level apprenticeships, annual performance and development review and access to a wide range of professional CPD programmes delivered in-house and via school's online learning platforms.
Core Values: School fundamental belief that the way school work, with their behaviours and priorities should be guided by school values - Honesty, Everyone Counts, Accountability, Respect and Teamwork (HEART).

the-college-swansea-university.name: The College, Swansea University
the-college-swansea-university.about:
Located in a dedicated building on the Bay Campus, The College gives students the opportunity to settle into university life and stay on track to obtain their Swansea University degree. When students start their studies with Swansea they have access to all the facilities and services that a direct entry Swansea University student has, including Swansea University’s Global Alumni Network. Students can make valuable connections with alumni across the world who can offer mentoring opportunities and careers advice.
The College, Swansea University offers academic Pathways at Swansea University that lead to undergraduate and postgraduate degrees. Their unique approach to education transforms international students into Swansea University graduates and lifelong learners. Students can study Foundation, First Year, and Pre-Master's pathway programmes at The College in various subjects.
Why The College, Swansea University
Location: Swansea is a medium-sized city by UK standards and has a modern, cosmopolitan feel. Swansea has plans in place for the development of a 3,500 seat arena, Digital District and world-class leisure and retail offerings- making it a very exciting place to be!
Academic Support: Within The College students will be allocated a Personal Tutor and have a friendly Academic and Student Experience team who are on hand to help. In addition to this, students can also access all of the University support teams which cover a range of areas including pastoral care, study support and career success.
Accommodation: All students studying at The College are invited to stay at the Bay Campus accommodation. Here they have safe, secure and convenient accommodation, just a few minutes walk from The College academic teaching building.

the-university-of-sheffield-internationa.name: The University of Sheffield International College
the-university-of-sheffield-internationa.about:
The University of Sheffield International College gives you the perfect introduction to studying abroad. We teach more than 2,000 students every year, preparing them for the challenges of studying their undergraduate or postgraduate degree at a top-ranking Russell Group University.
For many international students, studying abroad brings some challenges that need a little extra support. Our international pathway programmes are delivered by Study Group and developed in collaboration with academics from the University, so you will know what to expect during your degree.
Why The University of Sheffield (StudyGroup)
History of excellence: Every one of its faculties is a centre of excellence and it has an outstanding track record for research and partnerships with industry. What's more, the International College has a bespoke new building, ideal for international students and central to the city. Sheffield is one of the 24 universities that make up the Russell Group. This is a collection of leading UK research universities committed to driving research and providing the very best teaching and learning experience.
Strong international support: Over 8,000 international students from 150 countries currently study at the University of Sheffield. It’s a place where new ideas are encouraged and nurtured. The University of Sheffield will encourage students questioning spirit and present exciting new developments in the student's chosen field.
Awesome on-campus facilities and extracurriculars: Students will find excellent facilities, study areas and the number 1 Students’ Union in the country. The University of Sheffield International College is located on the main campus.

university-of-aberdeen-international-stu.name: University of Aberdeen International Study Centre
university-of-aberdeen-international-stu.about:
The University of Aberdeen International Study Centre is located at the heart of the historic King’s College Campus. It offers a full range of subject options and pathways, including tailored programs in engineering and medical studies.
The UK’s fifth oldest university, Aberdeen has been offering life-changing learning opportunities for more than 500 years. Today, it adds to this rich heritage with modern facilities and a 21st-century outlook. Represented by 130 nationalities, the University has an international community and is committed to equality and diversity.
The University of Aberdeen strives to be one of the world’s top research-intensive universities. Associated with five Nobel Prize winners, it is known for learning and research excellence. Students at Aberdeen benefit from a personalized experience and flexible learning. Honours students receive a broad and flexible education within the Scottish four-year degree system.
Why the University of Aberdeen
History: Aberdeen is among the UKs ancient univiersities, with a founding date in 1495.
Campus: Aberdeen boasts impressive facilities both inside and outside of the classroom - and features a blend of historic and modern buildings.
Facilities: Students will benefit from access to world class facilities including the Sir Duncan Rice Library, and Aberdeen Sports Village.
Culture: With students from more than 130 nations represented on campus, the University of Aberdeen boasts a strong multicultural community, and international students will benefit from both the international community as well as Scotland's own distinct culture.

university-of-birmingham-foundation-path.name: University of Birmingham Foundation Pathways
university-of-birmingham-foundation-path.about:
Located in the UK's second largest city, the University of Birmingham is a world top 100 university. It has an established history of excellence in education and research in the following fields: Arts and Law; Engineering and Physical Sciences; Life and Environmental Sciences; Medical and Dental Sciences; and Social Sciences. Students from all around the world come to the University of Birmingham to receive an education of the highest quality that will broaden their horizons and prepare them for a successful career and bright future.
Along with an array of direct-entry undergraduate programs, the University of Birmingham offers foundation pathways that are university-delivered courses that prepare international students for an undergraduate degree at the University of Birmingham. Students will be taught by Birmingham’s world-leading academics, who are experts in their fields, and will help them develop their language and academic skills, as well as subject knowledge, so that students are fully ready for their undergraduate degree.
There are 5 foundation pathways to choose from, all designed to prepare students for their specific degree area and tailored to fit different English language levels:
Arts, Social Sciences, Business and Law
Engineering and Physical Sciences
Medical, Life and Geo Sciences
Medicine and Physiotherapy
Social Sciences, Business and Law
Why University of Birmingham Foundation Pathways (Kaplan International Pathways)
Campus: The beautiful and historic 250-acre campus is the perfect home away from home, with one of the largest communities of international students in the UK - over 10,000 students from more than 150 countries.
Facilities: The university is well-equipped with cutting-edge facilities and one of the UK's largest academic libraries.

university-of-bradford-international-col.name: University of Bradford International College (UBIC)
university-of-bradford-international-col.about:
The University of Bradford International College (UBIC) is an embedded college located in the centre of the University of Bradford in West Yorkshire, England. UBIC offers pathway programmes for international students to prepare them for undergraduate and postgraduate studies in the UK.
The pathway programmes offer students various routes to a degree. Depending on level of study, English language ability, and subject area, the first stages at Bradford may be through the following pathways:
International Foundation Year (IFY)
International Year Zero (IYZ)
International Year One (IY1)
International Incorporated Masters (IIM)
Why University of Bradford International College:
Enhancing English skills: By studying at UBIC, students will improve their academic and English language skills. They will be prepared for their future studies at the University of Bradford, a top 25 UK university for graduate prospects (The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide, 2019).
Diverse community: UBIC was awarded the Queen's anniversary prize for higher and further education, continually providing high-quality academic teaching with industry expertise to a global community of over 130 different nationalities.
Research and teaching quality: University of Bradford is a technology with over 50 years of innovation and excellence. The university is a part of the World Technology Universities Network, and is silver rated in the Teaching Excellence Framework.

university-of-brighton-international-col.name: University of Brighton International College
university-of-brighton-international-col.about:
The University of Brighton International College (UBIC) offers pathway courses in partnership with the University of Brighton for international students who seek additional preparation for university study. Located within the University of Brighton campus, UBIC students have access to the excellent facilities of the University and everything they need to follow their paths to a University of Brighton degree.
The University of Brighton is a progressive, modern school in one of Britain's most exciting, lively cities. It is career-focused with excellent facilities and business connections and, at its heart, it is an inventive institution with a creative spirit. The university now offers degrees in a variety of subjects, including Engineering, Fashion, Law, Medicine and Sociology.
A big part of the academic culture at the University of Brighton is about unlocking each student's potential by empowering students to do something they really love and succeed at it. Degrees at Brighton are generally quite flexible, and students are often can choose optional modules, work placements and volunteering opportunities that work to their strengths.
Why University of Brighton International College (Kaplan International Pathways)
Campus: Brighton's community is made up of students and staff from over 150 countries. There are more than 100 societies for students to expand their interests, meet like-minded people, and do something they love.
Facilities: The University of Brighton has four campuses, all with superb facilities, including sports halls, a swimming pool, dance studios, a newsroom, Psychology labs, world-class Design Archives, and more!
Location: Brighton is a student-friendly, artistic, and bustling city with famous beaches and a diverse global community.

university-of-essex-international-colleg.name: University of Essex International College
university-of-essex-international-colleg.about:
The University of Essex was founded in the 1960s as an innovative institution to challenge traditional thinking. It is highly ranked in many subjects, giving students the chance to advance their education in a field they love. It offers a beautiful main campus just outside the city of Colchester, which is only 1 hour from London by train. Essex is a hugely international university, with students of 140+ nationalities bringing great diversity of cultures and ideas, creating a truly global campus community.
Opened in 2018, the University of Essex International College is run by Kaplan International Pathways, and offers degree preparation courses in partnership with the University of Essex. These on-campus courses allow students to meet the University’s entry requirements, and progress to a bachelor’s or master’s degree. The College offers customised teaching and support for international students, who’ll also enjoy access to University of Essex facilities from day one. These include academic, sports and social facilities, plus clubs and societies, giving students the full Essex experience.
Why University of Essex International College (Kaplan International Pathways)
Expert Support: College staff are dedicated to helping international students and offer wide-ranging support. This includes adapting to life in Essex and the UK, academic and personal development, making new friends, resolving queries and challenges, and many other aspects of living and studying abroad.
Ideal Accommodation: On their pathway course, students can live in University of Essex accommodation that’s perfectly placed on campus, with easy access to classes, facilities and Colchester city centre.

university-of-huddersfield-international.name: University of Huddersfield International Study Centre
university-of-huddersfield-international.about:
The University of Huddersfield International Study Centre is dedicated to preparing international students with the academic and English language skills needed to successfully complete a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate degree study at the University of Huddersfield. Courses offered here will help students adjust to life in the UK and make sure students are fully equipped to enter their chosen degree as a comfortable and confident student.
The University of Huddersfield is among the UK's top providers of work placement courses and knows exactly how to prepare students for successful careers and a great future. The University is located in the centre of the thriving West Yorkshire town of Huddersfield and is ranked in the top five in the UK for student experience.
Why the University of Huddersfield
International student support: Students will be part of the University from day one with access to on-campus facilities, student organisations and events. The staff at the International Study Centre will ensure that students have all the support you need to transition smoothly to your chosen degree and continue to support students while they work to achieve their goals.
Highly ranked: The University of Huddersfield was ranked a top 50 University in the UK (Guardian University Guide, 2019), ranked 1st in England three years running (2016, 2017, 2018) for Professionally Qualified Teaching Staff (Higher Education Statistics Agency, 2016-2018), ranked 5th in the world and 3rd in the UK for Best Student Experience (International Barometer, 2015).

university-of-leeds-international-study-.name: University of Leeds International Study Centre
university-of-leeds-international-study-.about:
Leeds International Study Centre works in collaboration with the University of Leeds and Leeds Beckett University to prepare students from outside of the UK for successful degree study. The courses offer students the opportunity to study abroad in the UK, and provide additional support to students who do not meet the entry requirements to apply directly to either university.
Leeds Beckett University, established in 1824, is home to students from 144 countries. Degree courses at LBU are taught by expert academics who have close links with industry to ensure that students graduate with the skills, knowledge, and professional accreditation that is relevant to a future career. LBU achieved five out of five stars for employability in the QS World University Rankings 2021, and 94 percent of LBU graduates are in work or further study six months after graduating.
The University of Leeds, established in 1904, is one of the largest higher education institutes in the UK. They are globally renowned for their quality of teaching and research. The strength of their academic expertise, combined with the breadth of disciplines covered, provides a wealth of opportunities and has a real impact on the world in cultural, social, and economic ways. The University of Leeds strives to achieve academic excellence within an ethical framework informed by their values of integrity, equality and inclusion, community and professionalism.
Why Leeds International Study Centre
Access to research facilities and resources: Whichever subject students choose to study, research will be at the heart of their learning at the Leeds. Students will be close to the breakthroughs that are having a real impact on the world, and have the opportunity to get involved in research happening on campus.

university-of-liverpool-international-co.name: University of Liverpool International College
university-of-liverpool-international-co.about:
The University of Liverpool International College (UoLIC) offers pathway courses in partnership with the University of Liverpool, and is situated on the University campus. The College is fully equipped to help students follow their path to the prestigious University of Liverpool, with dedicated and experienced staff ready to support them every step of the way. Students can now study in a brand new, state-of-the-art College building with integrated accommodation, which opened in January 2020.
Based on University of Liverpool's campus in Liverpool, the College is fully integrated with the University and UoLIC students are given full access to university facilities while they prepare for their degree. 51 nationalities were represented by new students at the College in 2020. UoLIC offers courses to prepare students for both undergraduate and postgraduate degrees. The Foundation Certificate at University of Liverpool International College is designed to prepare students for entry to an undergraduate degree in a number of subject areas. UoLIC also offer a pathway for a Pre-Master's course to prepare international students for studying at postgraduate level at the University of Liverpool.
Why University of Liverpool International College
Rewarding Experience: Staff at the College make sure students get the most out of their experience studying abroad. They'll arrange trips where students can make new friends and see more of the city, and they'll be there to support students at every stage of their path to university.
Cultural Hub: Liverpool is a major cultural hub for the north of England. The University has adopted the same international and cultural diversity as the city itself. Liverpool thrives off its multicultural community.

university-of-nottingham-international-c.name: University of Nottingham International College
university-of-nottingham-international-c.about:
The University of Nottingham International College offers degree preparation courses in partnership with the University of Nottingham, and is situated right by University Park campus. This International College in Nottingham can help students follow their paths to a degree at the prestigious University, and will provide students with a life-changing student experience in an exciting UK city. For some courses, students will study at the Advanced Manufacturing Building in the Faculty of Engineering on the University’s Jubilee Campus. Wherever students choose to study, they will be on the right path!
Why University of Nottingham International College (Kaplan International Pathways)
Strong International Support: Over 9,000 international students from over 150 countries currently study at the University of Nottingham. This means that students will be exposed to diverse perspectives, experiences, and people.
Academic and Research Excellence: Nottingham is one of 24 universities that make up the Russell Group, a collection of leading UK research universities committed to driving research and providing the best teaching and learning experience. Nottingham ranks highly in many global university rankings, with Times Higher Education having shortlisted the school for its covered 'University of the Year' award on four occasions in the least ten years.
Athletics: Nottingham has many opportunities for those who want to play a sport at any level: from casual sport and University leagues, Nationwide university leagues, and elite athletes. The school runs 70 different sports clubs, covering a range of indoor and outdoor sports, martial arts, water sports, and outdoor pursuits.

university-of-plymouth-international-col.name: University of Plymouth International College (UPIC)
university-of-plymouth-international-col.about:
University of Plymouth International College (UPIC) offers international students a broad selection of undergraduate and postgraduate pathway options to prepare themselves for their studies at University of Plymouth. These programs are specially designed for students who don't have the high school leaving grades or level of English required to begin their studies at the university. Since 2009, UPIC has welcomed over 1,000 students from all over the world and supported them in their journey to University of Plymouth!
The University of Plymouth has a unique and proud heritage that dates back over 150 years. Students can look forward to high-quality, research-informed teaching that will prepare them for their careers after graduation.
Why University of Plymouth International College
Campus: From day one, students become part of the community and experience UK university life because UPIC is located right on the university campus!
Location: Plymouth is Britain's Ocean City, a vibrant coastal city in the South West surrounded by stunning nature. It is an ideal place to live and study, and everything students need in terms of shopping, dining, and entertainment is within walking distance from campus.
Leaders in Marine Research: University of Plymouth is ranked #1 by Times Higher Education Impact Rankings (2021).
International student experience: With students from all over the world, University of Plymouth is ranked top 5 in the UK for international student experience (WhatUni Student Choice Awards, 2018).
Graduate careers: University of Plymouth graduates have gone on to work for leading global companies such as Apple, EY, Microsoft Unilever, and the United Nations.

university-of-strathclyde-international-.name: University of Strathclyde International Study Centre
university-of-strathclyde-international-.about:
The University of Strathclyde International Study Centre provides specialist degree preparation for international students studying abroad. Once students have successfully completed their preparation programme and met the progression criteria, they can begin their chosen university degree. They aim to give students the best chance of success when they progress to their degree at the University of Strathclyde.
The University of Strathclyde is a leading international technological university and its reputation and influence are global. With a community of more than 23,000 students, studying at the University of Strathclyde is a fantastic experience, where students will enjoy flexible, innovative learning and excellent facilities. The school is renowned for its excellent teaching, world-class research and strong links with industry, government and business. In addition to its exceptional range of industrial placements, internships and scholarships, the University of Strathclyde offers a host of clubs and societies, volunteering opportunities and membership of Scotland’s largest Students’ Union.
Why the University of Strathclyde International Study Centre
Access to University Facilities: Students will be part of the University from the day they arrive at the International Study Centre. This means they will have access to all the campus facilities, including the library, Centre for Sport & Recreation and Students' Union. They will also have access to additional resources available at the International Study Centre.
Personal Monitoring and Support: Students will receive specialist support during their studies, as well as regular assessments to monitor their progress, including examinations and coursework.

university-of-surrey-international-study.name: University of Surrey International Study Centre
university-of-surrey-international-study.about:
At the University of Surrey International Study Centre students can pursue programs for a range of interests from creative arts, to business, sciences and engineering. Each program introduces students to the UK style of teaching while raising students' academic skills, English language level and study skills. The International Foundation Year and the Pre-Masters each offer a choice of three academic routes. Once a student completes their program and achieves the required grades, they can start their degree at the University of Surrey.
The University of Surrey is a global community of ideas and people, dedicated to life-changing education and research. The University of Surrey was established in 1966 via Royal Charter, and currently boasts a community of over 16,000 students, and more than 6,000 international students. With a beautiful and vibrant campus, the University provides exceptional teaching and practical learning to inspire and empower students for personal and professional success. Top subjects include: Modern Languages and Linguistics, Engineering (Electronic and Electrical), Sociology, Veterinary Science, Music, Chemistry, Criminology, Food Science, Nursing, and Hospitality, Leisure and Tourism.
Why the University of Surrey International Study Centre
Location: Surrey is the perfect student location between the countryside and UK's capital, with history, recreation and leisure options, and plenty of shopping and entertainment venues. It is only a 35 minute drive to Heathrow airport and less that 40 minutes by train to Central London.
Graduate Employment: The University of Surrey has been awarded the prestigious accolade of University of the Year for Graduate Employment in the Times/Sunday Times Good University Guide for 2022.

university-of-sussex-international-study.name: University of Sussex International Study Centre
university-of-sussex-international-study.about:
With a curriculum that’s been carefully designed to align with courses at the university, studying at the International Study Centre gives you the best opportunity to fulfil your ambition of becoming a student at the University of Sussex. In choosing to study at Sussex, you will be joining an international community of staff and students from over 145 countries.
The University of Sussex International Study Centre is the start of your academic journey in the UK. Sussex’s campus and unique location close to a national park and vibrant city of Brighton make it a wonderful place to call home during this exciting time in your life. Here you will make lifelong friends and develop the skills and confidence you need for success in your degree and future career.
Why Sussex International Study Centre
Ground-breaking research centres - including the Genome Damage and Stability Centre, the Sussex Centre for Migration Research and the Sackler Centre for Consciousness Science
Historical resource centre - The Keep is just a short walk from the Sussex campus and is home to the Mass Observation Archive and Special Collections
State-of-the-art exhibition centre - the Attenborough Centre for the Creative Arts offers exhibitions, performance, teaching and research. The Centre has a state-of-the-art flexible auditorium with 350 seats, gallery and display areas, rehearsal studios, breakout spaces and a new café
£30 million building - the Jubilee Building features a 500-seat lecture theatre, seminar rooms, cluster rooms, social spaces and a café
Modern teaching space - the £10 million Fulton building offers two 160-seat lecture theatres, as well as a flexible social and meeting space.

university-of-the-west-of-england-bristo.name: University of the West of England Bristol International College
university-of-the-west-of-england-bristo.about:
The University of the West of England (UWE) Bristol’s International College offers pathway courses in partnership with UWE Bristol, and is integrated into the University campus. The College is fully equipped to help students prepare for their university degree. With dedicated and experienced staff and outstanding facilities, students will be supported at every step as they start their path to university. Students at UWE Bristol’s International College can choose from a number of courses, with progression to undergraduate or postgraduate degrees.
A pathway course at UWE Bristol's International College (UWEBIC) will provide students with the skills they need to study a degree course at UWE Bristol. As well as English language study, students will learn academic and subject-based skills to help them prepare for university. The College has three pathway options available to students: Foundation Year, International Year One, and Pre-Masters. If students successfully complete their pathway course at the required level, they are guaranteed entry to their chosen undergraduate or postgraduate degrees at UWE Bristol.
Why University of the West of England (UWE) Bristol International College
Location: Bristol is a beautiful city with a lively harbourside area, where students will find lots of cafés and restaurants overlooking the water. Students will find lots of street art here, as well as plenty of museums, art galleries, shops and parks.
Fantastic Facilities: The College is equipped with everything students need for their studies, and from the first day students will have access to UWE Bristol's advanced facilities like a production studio, and the UK's largest robotics lab, as well as the amenities of the Students' Union.

university-of-york-international-pathway.name: University of York International Pathway College
university-of-york-international-pathway.about:
Established in 1963, the University of York is among the best universities in the UK, being ranked top 20 overall top 25 for graduate prospects (Complete University Guide 2023). It offers students a beautiful campus with modern facilities, in one of the UK’s safest and most friendly cities. As a Russell Group university, York is a leader in research, which translates into excellent and relevant teaching for students. The University’s diverse campus community is home to more than 20,000 students from over 150 countries, so it’s easy to feel welcome and at home here.
Opened in 2016, the University of York International Pathway College is a partnership between Kaplan International Pathways and the University of York. It’s based on campus, and offers pathway courses that allow international students to prepare for, and qualify for entry to, a University of York bachelor’s or master’s degree. With outstanding facilities in the modern £27 million Piazza Building, the Pathway College offers expert teaching and specialist support. Students have everything they need to follow their path to academic success.
Why the University of York International Pathway College (Kaplan International Pathways)
Dedicated support: Pathway College staff have expert experience in helping international students, and can offer support in many areas. This includes settling into life in York, making academic and personal progress, building new friendships, solving any concerns, and much more.
Convenient accommodation: during the pathway course, students can stay in University accommodation ideally located on campus, with easy access to classes, facilities and the city centre.
Ideal student city: York is a brilliant mix of old and new.
