arden-university.name: Arden University
arden-university.about:
Arden University provides access to the skills, knowledge, and opportunities learners need to further their careers and achieve the success they deserve.
As an innovative and applied university, Arden’s cutting-edge digital learning platforms contain all the support students need to succeed. The University was recognised in the latest National Student Survey in 2025 as No 5 in the UK for student satisfaction and has more than 40,000 ambitious students learning with it. The university built its courses to reflect the needs of today’s students and employers, with many of its courses being developed hand in hand with modern business organisations.
Arden's industry accreditation and partnerships with institutions like the NHS, CMI, and CIPD provide students with the resources, insight, and opportunities to transform their careers and make a positive contribution to their communities.
Why Arden University - London Stratford
Location: Arden's newest London campus in Stratford offers world-class facilities in one of the city’s most exciting, vibrant, and well-connected areas. Located in the heart of Stratford Cross, just moments from Westfield Stratford City and the Olympic Park, the Turing Building campus is designed to help students succeed - with inspiring views, flexible learning spaces, and access to everything they need to succeed in their studies.
Student Satisfaction: Arden University's MBA is ranked the Best MBA in the UK by the CEO Magazine, 2024 and 2025. The University is also ranked Top 5 in the UK for Student Experience by NSS 2025. Over 90% of their students agree that staff make their subject engaging, say their course is developing the skills they need for the future, and believe that the library resources fully support their learning.

bangor-university.name: Bangor University
bangor-university.about:
Established in 1884, Bangor University has a long tradition of excellence and exceeds expectations, both for academic standards and student experience. Bangor is a strong, confident institution recognised regionally, nationally and internationally as a centre of excellence for its varied portfolio of teaching and research, and for the unique, multicultural, inclusive experience it provides for its staff and students.
Bangor University has a long tradition of academic excellence and a strong focus on the student experience. Around 10,000 students currently study at the University, with teaching staff based within fourteen Academic Schools. It is ranked in the top 40 in the UK for research*, according to the Research Excellence Framework (REF) 2014. The REF recognised that more than three-quarters of Bangor’s research is either world-leading or internationally excellent, ahead of the average for UK universities. Research is central to Bangor University; it is an integral part of its teaching and a passion of all academic staff. The 2014 Research Excellence Framework recognised that more than three-quarters of Bangor’s research is either world-leading or internationally excellent, ahead of the average for all UK universities. Bangor researchers come from over 30 countries worldwide, and collaborate with colleagues from over 120 nations.
Why Bangor University?
Location: Students can live in one of the most scenic locations in the UK as they study. Nestled between the mountains and the sea, Bangor is more than just beautiful: it’s a playground for nature lovers. Hike, climb, kayak or canoe in nearby Snowdonia National Park, head to the beaches on Anglesey or take the plunge on Europe's fastest zip wire.

bath-spa-university.name: Bath Spa University
bath-spa-university.about:
Bath Spa University is a UK-based institution renowned for its emphasis on creativity, culture, and enterprise. It offers a diverse range of programs across arts, sciences, education, social sciences, and business, aiming to equip students with the skills and support needed to pursue their passions .
Established in 1852 as the Bath School of Art, the university has a rich heritage in the arts. Notably, artists such as Walter Sickert and Howard Hodgkin have been associated with the institution. In the post-war era, it relocated to Corsham Court and became a significant player in the English Modernist movement .
Why Bath Spa University
International Engagement: The university is committed to fostering global connections through its International Strategy, which includes initiatives like GALA, Go Global, and European Projects. These programs aim to enhance teaching and research by embedding international perspectives across all activities .
Student Support and Wellbeing: Bath Spa University prioritizes student wellbeing, offering services that address mental health, disability support, and financial guidance. The Student Wellbeing Services provide resources to help students navigate university life successfully .
Sustainability and Values: The university embraces a strong environmental ethos, with students and staff actively contributing to high environmental standards. Their commitment to sustainability is evident through various initiatives and a dedicated climate pledge .

birmingham-city-university.name: Birmingham City University
birmingham-city-university.about:
The Birmingham City University offers a range of subjects and specialisms across six Schools - Arts; Business; Law and Social Sciences; Architecture, Built Environment, Computing and Engineering; Life and Health Sciences; and Nursing and Midwifery - as well as the Royal Birmingham Conservatoire. The university’s early history can be traced back to 1843 with the founding of the Birmingham Society of Arts and School of Design. Over time, five individual colleges were brought together to form The City of Birmingham Polytechnic in 1971, which later became Birmingham City University.
With around 31,000 students from 100 countries (HESA Student Record 2021/22 © Higher Education Statistics Agency Limited), Birmingham City University is recognised as a large and diverse institution. The university places students at the centre of its activities, focusing on providing them with the best opportunities for future success.
Why Birmingham City University (BCU)
Industry-Standard Facilities: BCU has invested over £500 million across its campuses and facilities. The university’s developments include the state-of-the-art Parkside Building, which houses four film and TV studios, and the simulated operating theatre and hospital wards at the City South Campus. These investments aim to provide students with the best possible learning environments.
International Scholarships: BCU provides a variety of undergraduate and postgraduate scholarship opportunities for international students, aimed at supporting them throughout their studies.
Employability Support: While studying in the UK, students at BCU have the opportunity to gain valuable, paid work experience through flexible on-campus jobs.

bournemouth-university.name: Bournemouth University
bournemouth-university.about:
Bournemouth University is an innovative and vibrant public university located in Bournemouth, Dorset, a coastal town famous for its seven-mile stretch of sandy beaches. The town of Bournemouth has a population roughly 500,000 and is a thriving hub for several industries including the creative, financial, and tourism sectors. Bournemouth University boasts a strong student community with over 19,000 students and more than 2,600 international students. Bournemouth University offers students many innovative and industry-focused programs, with particular strengths in media and communication and technology. Students will benefit from close ties to industry and many of BU's programs offer industry accreditation or placements with over 1,500 industry partners.
Lansdowne Campus is located just outside of the town centre, housing six teaching and administrative buildings as well as various halls of residence and the student union's night-club. It is home to the Faculty of Health and Social Sciences, alongside several graduate programs from the Faculty of Management.
Why Bournemouth UniversityCampus: Lansdowne Campus is a short walk to the town centre and home to the Faculty of Health & Social Sciences and the Executive Business Centre, where postgraduate education for the Faculty of Management is delivered.
Economic Region: Bournemouth is home to UK's fastest growing digital economy, and one of the UK's largest financial centres outside of London.
Facilities: The majority of Bournemouth University's accommodation is based in Lansdowne, as well as being conveniently located to the main train and bus station. The university bus offers frequent and easy access connecting the two campuses.

canterbury-christ-church-university.name: Canterbury Christ Church University
canterbury-christ-church-university.about:
Canterbury Christ Church University (CCCU) started out as a teacher training college in the 1960s in response to a national shortage of teachers. Today they continue to shape their courses and research around critical social issues both nationally and globally. In 2022, they celebrated their Diamond Jubilee, marking 60 years of making a positive difference to people’s lives, through education, research and innovation. From teacher training in the early 1960s, adding professional health courses in the 80s, and now new creative arts, science, engineering, technology and medicine for future generations, their story is one of relevance, impact and progress.
InUni, a part of the Global University Systems (GUS) and one of the leading global education partners to help institutions attract diverse and quality students, across the globe. They aim to democratise the world through higher education, and partner with universities to offer customised, quality-focused and end-to-end solutions to meet their specific needs.
Why Canterbury Christ Church University?
Location: Less than an hour from London, Canterbury is a lively student city with historic streets, ancient city walls and a vibrant atmosphere. The Medway Campus is in an area known as Chatham Maritime, a student-friendly quarter.
Facilities: A multi-million pound investment is transforming the University, including a centre for science, technology, health, and engineering. CCCU also home to the Kent and Medway Medical School and a stunning creative arts facility.
Student Support: Canterbury Christ Church University want to give students the best possible experience, from registration to graduation. The services are available to support students at whatever point they are in their university journey.

cardiff-metropolitan-university.name: Cardiff Metropolitan University
cardiff-metropolitan-university.about:
Founded in 1865 and located in the capital of Wales, Cardiff Metropolitan University delivers professionally recognised degrees, together with impactful research and innovation, in art and design, business and management, education and public services, sport and health sciences, and technologies and engineering. Whether students are lo​o​king for undergraduate​ or postgraduate study, Cardiff Metropolitan University is an excellent choice for international students choosing to study in the UK.​ The University has two campus locations; Llandaff and Cyncoed. Llandaff is the home of theCardiff School of Sport & Health Sciences (Llandaff), Cardiff School of Management, ​​​Cardiff School of Technologies and the ​​​Cardiff School of Art & Design​ while Cyncoed is home to the Cardiff School of Education & Social Policy and the Cardiff School of Sport & Health Sciences.
Cardiff Metropolitan is a collaborative and compassionate community, their values of creativity, diversity, freedom and innovation are lived through the behaviours of their staff and students; by their leadership, trust, courage and accountability to each other, and to their partners. The school is home to approximately 11,000 students, with over 1200 international students from more than 143 countries. International students are value​d and respected for the unique experiences and perspectives that they contribute to university life, enriching the study experience for all students.
Why Cardiff Metropolitan University
The Cardiff Met EDGE: The university works in partnership with students to instil the Cardiff Met EDGE - a series of Ethical, Digital, Global and Entrepreneurial skills to develop students' confidence, resilience and experiences that will them for life after university and through to employment.

cardiff-university.name: Cardiff University
cardiff-university.about:
Founded in 1883, Cardiff University is established as one of Britain's leading research universities. Cardiff is a global, ambitious and innovative university with a bold and strategic vision located in a beautiful and thriving capital city.
They have a diverse student population with students coming from more than 100 countries and with a range of backgrounds. Academic staff are driven by creativity and curiosity and many are leaders in their fields, creating a stimulating environment for learning. They work in partnership with our students to create a stimulating and supportive environment in which all our students can thrive.
Why Cardiff University - Cathays Park
Research: Cardiff University excels in producing high quality, innovative research which translates into benefits both locally and worldwide. Their research expertise and facilities are used by industry and commercial partners, government bodies and other organisations internationally. Their research earns grants and investments totalling tens of millions of pounds and attracts top researchers from around the world. Cardiff University's research contracts have a total value of £500M.
Sought-After Graduates: 95% of Cardiff's graduates were in employment and/or further study, due to start a new job or course, or doing other activities, such as travelling. Cardiff University has 205,000 alumni in 202 countries.
Location: Cardiff University is made up of two large, well-located campuses, both located in Cardiff. The Cathays Park campus is where most of the Academic Schools are based. With wide tree-lined avenues and elegant Portland stone buildings, it's an inspiring place to study. Healthcare-related courses (excluding Pharmacy and Optometry) are based at Heath Park.

Coventry University is a forward-looking, modern university with a proud tradition as a provider of high quality education and a focus on applied research. Students benefit from state-of-the-art equipment and facilities in all academic disciplines including health, design and engineering laboratories, and performing arts studios and computing centres.
Students with international experience obtain higher starting salaries, develop the global skills employers require and achieve better career progression. The dedicated Centre for Global Engagement (CGE) offers a range of programmes and funding to assist students in widening their international experience including language classes, studying or working abroad, international fieldtrips, global research, cultural workshops, Summer Schools, leadership development or work experience in the UK.
Why Coventry University
Employability: Coventry University focus on increasing the employability of students and have a range of industry-leading initiatives to help prepare you for graduate employment. The Talent Team can help you to find work experience, join international field trips or study towards industry qualifications. And, unlike many universities, if you choose to undertake an optional work placement or study abroad year, you won’t be charged a tuition fee.
Teaching: Coventry courses are dynamic, interactive and stimulating, designed to bring your subject to life.
Location: Coventry is a vibrant and diverse student city, located in the centre of the UK and only 1 hour from London by train. The single-site campus is located at the heart of Coventry, so everything you need is within a few minutes’ walk.

de-montfort-university.name: De Montfort University
de-montfort-university.about:
De Montfort University (DMU) is located in the welcoming and multicultural city of Leicester, just over an hour from London. DMU is a vibrant, multicultural hub of creativity and innovation that never surrenders to convention. They offer the perfect combination of award-winning teaching, world-class facilities and a fantastic student experience. as well as more than 300 courses at foundation, undergraduate and postgraduate, many of which offer professional accreditations, links to industry or work experience. Each year more than 2,700 international students from more than 130 countries choose to study with them.
De Montfort University is immensely proud of it's brilliant home city and it's part in its great history, exciting transformation and future success. Diverse and multicultural, but with its own confident character, Leicester has been named one of the best UK cities in which to live and work. Located in the heart of England, Leicester offers students a vibrant hub of entertainment, commerce and culture - and the city centre is just 1,700 steps or a five-minute walk away from the DMU campus.
One can do something different every day in Leicester: shop until one drops in stores ranging from independent, quirky boutiques to high street favourites; laugh until one cries, especially at the Leicester Comedy Festival; or dance until dawn at any number of clubs. Alternatively, thanks to the city’s diversity and culture, students can eat their way around the globe and they also have their choice of museums, theatres and cinemas.

At Edinburgh Napier they nurture talent and create knowledge that shapes communities all around the world. Their innovative research provides solutions to society's challenges, their graduates leave ready for the workplace, and they have wide-ranging links with employers and business. Edinburgh Napier comprises six schools with an international focus, each committed to growing their academic reputation, delivering an excellent personalised student experience and building innovation, enterprise and citizenship.
ENU has three campuses in Edinburgh offering advanced facilities for learning, teaching and research. Based in an iconic, prosperous city and a stunning, ambitious forward thinking country, Edinburgh Napier is a great place to live, work and study. Home to the Business School, Craiglockhart campus blends the old and the new. Set within attractive grounds overlooking Edinburgh, facilities include 200- and 400-seat lecture theatres and language and multimedia labs. It's also home to ENU’s innovation and enterprise centre.
Why Edinburgh Napier University - Craiglockhart Campus?
Facilities: Students will find all the facilities required to produce graduates ready to succeed in the world of business including: 200-seat Lindsay Stewart lecture theatre; Second 400-seat lecture theatre; Multimedia and language labs; Extensive library and access to more than 100 computers; Light and airy double-height atrium with Starbucks coffee shop; Bright Red Triangle business incubator and Bright Red Ventures consultancy; and The War Poets Collection
Academic and Research Excellence: ENU is the top ranked Scottish modern university in the Times/Sunday Times Good University Guide 2021.

Location: Study and live in the world's best student city. Located in the heart of London close to iconic landmarks. The Health Business School is located at the London campus on Borough High Street, in a vibrant neighbourhood just a short walk from London Bridge and the River Thames.
Staff Expertise: Teaching staff are drawn from a variety of health and business backgrounds to offer unique insights for students. Course structure, academic content and teaching methods equip Business School graduates to launch a successful and rewarding career contributing positively to the future of healthcare across the world.
Exceptional Student Support: From academic support to pastoral care, students are treated with care and compassion. Health Sciences University puts people and well-being at the heart of everything they do. They aim to deliver a positive student experience and good graduate outcomes through expertise, care and compassion.

heriot-watt-university.name: Heriot-Watt University
heriot-watt-university.about:
Heriot-Watt University is a product of the Scottish Enlightenment. A pioneer in bringing education to working people in 1821 and founder of a global movement through the creation of the world's first Mechanics Institute. Heriot-Watt is a university with global presence and a visionary international strategy. Since the early 1990s, they have built sustainable academic partnerships with institutions across the globe from the US to the Ukraine and from China to Trinidad and Tobago. They continue to push new frontiers in the fields of science, technology, engineering, business, and design.
Why Heriot-Watt University- Edinburgh?
Location: Edinburgh is a really lively city with plenty to see and do. It's a great city for cultural events with something happening every day of the week. Whether it's music, film, theatre, comedy or the arts, students are bound to find plenty going on of interest.
Facilities: At Heriot-Watt University, they offer a wide range of services to help students deal with all aspects of their life, whether these be academic, personal, technical, financial or just plain fun. The Student Services are on hand to support students' learning through a wide range of provision including accommodation, computing, healthcare, sport, welfare and careers. University support complements the services and facilities offered through the Students' Association.
Globally Connected: The university, one of Scotland's most international universities having around a third of their students from outside, have 5 campuses and 150 learning partners around the world. Many of their students get the chance to transfer their study to campuses in Dubai and Malaysia through their Go Global inter-campus exchange programme.

Based in one of the world's most exciting capital cities, London Metropolitan University is home to a diverse community of inspiring and determined learners, teachers and innovative thinkers. They offer a wide range of courses, from undergraduate and postgraduate degrees to short courses and professional qualifications. London Metropolitan University takes pride in helping students reach their goals and succeed in their careers. At London Metropolitan University, students are placed at the centre of everything. London Metropolitan University is constantly reviewing their courses to respond to the demands of the job market and give students a diverse choice. London Metropolitan University is committed to providing students with the best possible support and resources.
London Metropolitan University's dedicated careers and employability team will support and advise students both during and after their studies. London Metropolitan University runs a mentoring scheme, which can put students in touch with a professional from their chosen sector, as well as a graduate internship scheme, which offers around 30 paid internships each year. Many courses include work placement modules that count towards a final degree and many are accredited by professional bodies, which will give student qualifications extra weight.
London Metropolitan University is proud of their vibrant, multi-ethnic and socially diverse community, and encourage students to join them - they currently have more than 120 nationalities studying at the university.

Founded in 1909, Loughborough University is proud of its long history as an institution of further and higher education. Today, it is one of the country’s leading universities, with a reputation for excellence in teaching and research, strong links with business and industry and unrivaled sporting achievement. The school's teaching and learning offers academic excellence in a broad range of disciplines, from sport and exercise science to engineering, business and the arts, and it was recently awarded Gold in the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF).
In 2015, Loughborough opened a second campus on Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park in London. The campus is based in the former press and broadcast centres at the 2012 Olympic and Paralympic Games, and currently offers 32 full and part-time master's programmes and 7 PhD programmes. The London campus has diversified and expanded the high quality education offered by Loughborough to both postgraduate students and those looking to advance their professional development.
Loughborough offers a renowned student experience by giving every student the opportunity they need to achieve their full potential - professionally, academically and socially. Students at Loughborough have access to a truly global experience, where they are taught by academics from across the world; they can study abroad or complete an overseas placement, and have numerous opportunities to learn a new language. The university's strong connections to industry boost these opportunities by providing students with access to placements.
Why Loughborough University
Campus life: The school's community is made up of an exciting cluster of innovators, collaborators, and forward thinkers in education, business, technology, and media.

northumbria-university-newcastle.name: Northumbria University (Newcastle)
northumbria-university-newcastle.about:
Northumbria University is a research-intensive University that unlocks potential for all, changing lives regionally, nationally and internationally. Named UK University of the Year 2022 by Times Higher Education and Modern University of the Year 2025 by The Times and The Sunday Times, it is based in Newcastle upon Tyne, with an additional campus in London. Originating from Rutherford College (founded in 1880), Northumbria is ranked in the UK’s top 25 for research power and graduate employment. The university works with leading employers like Nike, IBM, and the NHS, and is a top UK institution for graduate start-ups. Northumbria attracts students from 137 countries and collaborates globally with higher education institutions.
Why Northumbria University - Newcastle
Mission: Northumbria University's mission is to change lives through education and research, addressing global challenges to transform society and the economy.
Vision: By 2030, Northumbria aims to be a university that, through world-leading research and transformative education, enables individuals from all backgrounds to succeed and supports businesses and communities in the North East, London, and beyond to thrive.
History: Northumbria University's origins trace back to Rutherford College, founded in 1880. Over the years, it evolved through various educational institutions, culminating in the establishment of Northumbria University. A detailed account of this evolution is documented in "Rutherford's Ladder: The Making of Northumbria University, 1871-1996," published by Northumbria University Press.

ravensbourne-university.about:
Ravensbourne University London is a specialist, industry-focused university on the vibrant Greenwich Peninsula collaborating with the creative industries to give their students the skills and opportunities they need to kick-start their careers. They have a community of approximately 2,600 students and offer practically focused digital media and design courses from pre-degree, undergraduate and postgraduate to professional short course level. Driven by industry standards and supported by the latest high-performance technology, they produce highly employable and enterprising graduates. Ravensbourne has a strong track record in graduate employability and business creation.
Ravensbourne also hosts alongside its student community more than 100 creative technology businesses that utilise its leading edge technologies and media resources, and collaborate with its student body and industry partners. Students are professional creatives from the day they join the university. Ravensbourne works in close partnership with employers to foster the mindsets and skillsets that the creative industries need.
Why Ravensbourne University London?
Location: Ravensbourne is located at the heart of London’s newest permanent creative community on the Greenwich Peninsula. Thanks to recent investment, this stretch of London riverside has gone from marshy bog-land to a thriving public space, filled with creative businesses, a 3km art trail, restaurants, cafes, hotels and entertainment juggernaut, the O2 arena.
Student Services: Ravensbourne supports its students, from specialist tutoring and mentoring, to counselling and career services.

regent-college.name: Regent College
regent-college.about:
Regent College London was formed in 2010 as part of  Regent Group, an education, training, and investment management business founded by the Pankaj family. They share a rich and successful history in education, characterised by compact campuses, small, focused classes, and unparalleled support. The college initially opened in Wembley, delivering BTEC Higher National Diplomas and providing students with alternative progression routes into Higher Education. In 2013, they opened admissions to the public to reflect their commitment to widening access and participation. Since then, they have been delivering a range of HND business programmes validated by Pearson. They have also expanded their Higher Education provision, working with a collection of university partners to deliver Foundation Year Routes, Foundation Degrees, Bachelor’s Degrees, Top-up Degrees, and Master’s Degrees.
As a college, they have achieved many goals, such as a positive outcome for QAA Higher Education Review, excellent results in the National Student Survey, opening five campus locations across London, and of course, helping its students achieve their lifelong goals and aspirations.
Why Regent College London (in partnership with University of Greater Manchester)?
Partner University: Regent College London (RCL) is the London academic centre for the University of Greater Manchester. International students studying at RCL will graduate with a University of Greater Manchester degree. The University of Greater Manchester prides itself on being a teaching-intensive, research-informed institution and was recently awarded an overall Silver rating in the Teaching Excellence Framework 2023, with a Gold rating in Student Experience.

roehampton-university.name: Roehampton University
roehampton-university.about:
The University of Roehampton is a modern university located in south-west London, near the affluent and picturesque Richmond. Students can enjoy living and learning on a beautiful green campus whilst making the most of all the leisure, cultural, sporting, and networking opportunities London has to offer. The university evolved from four teacher training colleges, the first of which, Whitelands College, was established in 1841. The others are Digby Stuart (1874), Froebel College (1892), and Southlands College (1970s), which together make up the now modern campus.
In 1975, the four institutions federated to create Roehampton Institute of Higher Education, which became the University of Roehampton in 2011. The university retains a collegiate format, so students have the opportunity to create bonds with other students in their college as well as on their course.
The University of Roehampton offers a unique academic experience; a beautiful, vibrant parkland campus environment in the heart of bustling south-west London, only 30 minutes from the West End.
The University of Roehampton prides themselves on the guarantee that they make to all of their students: high levels of contact time with excellent teachers and researchers working at the cutting edge of their subject areas.
The mission of the University of Roehampton is simple. The University of Roehampton supports all of their students, whatever their background, to reach their full potential and prepare them for successful graduate careers. the University of Roehampton offers a diverse, dynamic curriculum of programmes delivered by academic staff engaged in world-class research.

Situated 19 miles from central London and seven miles from Heathrow Airport, it provides students with incredible access to London and the world. ulster-university-belfast-derry-colerain.name: Ulster University (Belfast, Derry, Coleraine)
ulster-university-belfast-derry-colerain.about:
Ulster University’s Coleraine Campus is a self-contained and welcoming campus located on the banks of the River Bann, just outside Coleraine town centre. The campus offers a relaxed community atmosphere while providing modern academic, sports and student facilities. Its location on Northern Ireland’s North Coast gives students easy access to beaches, outdoor activities and scenic coastal attractions.
The campus is close to the seaside towns of Portrush and Portstewart and is well connected by rail and bus, with the University Rail Halt around an eight-minute walk from campus. Students can enjoy attractions such as the Giant’s Causeway, coastal beaches and a range of water sports, making Coleraine an attractive option for students who enjoy outdoor and active lifestyles.
Why Ulster University - Coleraine?
Warm & Welcoming Community: The self-contained campus creates a friendly and close-knit student environment where students can connect with their peers and enjoy a relaxed university experience.
Scenic Riverside Location: The campus overlooks the River Bann and is surrounded by natural beauty, woodland areas and the North Coast, offering a peaceful setting for studying and student life.
Excellent Sports Facilities: Students have access to a state-of-the-art sports complex featuring multi-purpose sports halls, fitness and strength-and-conditioning suites, a sauna and steam room, outdoor pitches and tennis courts.
Vibrant Student Life: The campus includes the Riverside Theatre, Students’ Union, social spaces, catering facilities and accommodation, providing plenty of opportunities for students to socialise and participate in campus activities.

ulster-university-london-birmingham-and-.about:
Ulster University, Derry-Londonderry Campus is located in the heart of Northern Ireland’s second city, overlooking the River Foyle and within walking distance of Derry~Londonderry city centre. The campus offers an intimate and relaxed student environment while providing access to modern teaching, research and support facilities.
The Derry~Londonderry campus combines historic surroundings with a modern academic environment. Students can enjoy a vibrant city known for its arts, culture, festivals and historic landmarks, while the campus itself provides social, sports and accommodation facilities.
Why Ulster University - Derry~Londonderry?
Intimate Campus Environment: The campus offers a friendly and relaxed atmosphere, creating a close-knit learning community while still providing the experience of studying in a vibrant city.
Modern Learning Facilities: Significant investment has created state-of-the-art teaching, research and support facilities, including modern laboratories, lecture theatres, creative studios and specialist learning spaces.
Wide Range of Courses: The campus offers programmes across areas including business, law, nursing, sport, music, drama, education, computing and engineering, providing diverse academic opportunities.
Vibrant City Experience: Derry~Londonderry offers a rich cultural experience with historic attractions, arts, music, festivals, cafés, restaurants and entertainment venues. The city is also recognised for its lively and safe evening economy.

university-of-birmingham.name: University of Birmingham
university-of-birmingham.about:
From 1900 to the present day, the University of Birmingham has been at the forefront of both national and international research, leading the way in making ground-breaking progress in areas that span industries such as gene structure, medicine, space research and communications. For more than a century, the University of Birmingham has been pursuing and sharing knowledge through outstanding teaching and world-leading research. A global reputation, quality learning and teaching, excellent facilities, a stunning campus and great city are some of the reasons making the University of Birmingham a great place to study and live.
The University of Birmingham is the original ‘redbrick’ University, part of the prestigious Russell Group; their thriving student population enjoys a wide range of courses, and exceptional campus and research facilities. Their heritage as the original ‘redbrick’ is combined with one of the most compelling and ambitious agendas in higher education. The University of Birmingham has been transformed in recent years, characterised by major investments in academic staffing, investment of £1 billion in campus facilities, strong and improving outcomes for their students, annual growth in research performance, and bold new moves.
The 10 Nobel Laureates the University of Birmingham counts among their staff and alumni have contributed to some of science’s greatest discoveries, including in recent times the Higgs Boson and Gravitational Waves. The University of Birmingham's research provides innovative solutions to the challenges faced in their city, their region and across the globe.

university-of-bradford.about:
Study at the University of Bradford to benefit from - and be part of - teaching and research that harnesses technology for the good of society. At the University of Bradford, students will learn from academic and industry experts who are shaping the future of their sectors, and they'll learn in world-class facilities - they’ve invested millions of pounds in high-tech learning environments, such as their motion capture studio and Bloomberg Trading Room. Many of the courses at the University of Bradford have professional, statutory or regulatory body accreditation or approval, giving students the best possible start to their career.
Students will find a diverse mix of people from different backgrounds, faiths, nationalities and ages all sharing the close-knit City Campus at the University of Bradford. The Times and Sunday Times have named the University of Bradford as the UK’s University of the Year for Social Inclusion 2020. This prestigious national award recognises Bradford’s outstanding impact on social inclusion that ensures all students, irrespective of their background, are supported to achieve their potential and go on to achieve success.

Not only is the campus central it’s sustainable. With buildings made from hemp, beehives with student beekeepers, and edible gardens, sustainable development is embedded in University life. The University of Bradford regularly wins awards for their environmental initiatives, and their new developments are amongst the most sustainable buildings of their kind. Their campus is ranked the 4th greenest in the world.

university-of-brighton.name: University of Brighton
university-of-brighton.about:
University of Brighton is a progressive, modern school in one of Britain's most exciting, lively cities. It is career-focused with excellent facilities and business connections and, at its heart, it is an inventive institution with a creative spirit. The university offers degrees in a variety of subjects and City campus is home to its arts and humanities students. Located in the cultural heart of Brighton, City campus has specialist facilities, studio space and the university's world-class Design Archives which all make for a highly inspiring environment where creativity thrives.
A big part of the academic culture at University of Brighton is about unlocking each student's potential by empowering them to do something they really love and succeed at it. Degrees at Brighton are generally quite flexible, and students are often can choose optional modules, work placements and volunteering opportunities that work to their strengths.
Why University of Brighton?
Campus: Brighton's community is made up of students and staff from over 150 countries. There are more than 100 societies for students to expand their interests, meet like-minded people, and do something they love.

university-of-buckingham.name: University of Buckingham
university-of-buckingham.about:
The University of Buckingham is the only independent university in the UK with a Royal Charter, and probably the smallest with around 2,700 students. Honours degrees are achieved in two intensive years of study. We keep class sizes small, with a student:academic staff ratio of 10.4:1 and the Oxbridge style tutorial groups are often personalised and always exhilarating. The real basis of the University of Buckingham’s success has been its staff and, above all, students. Those who will graduate this year follow in a distinguished line and they and their successors will carry the reputation of the University to even greater heights.
The University of Buckingham has, in partnership with Apollo Hospitals Group, acquired the former Manchester Metropolitan University’s campus at Crewe. Crewe, close to both Liverpool and Manchester, is home to a range of allied health courses, including medicine (also taught in Buckingham), podiatry, biomedical science and postgraduate medicine. Our new Health Sciences Campus is well connected to the nearby town of Crewe, with a bus service running regularly to the centre and train station. The student accommodation is just a five-minute walk from your lecture theatres.
Building on from the Buckingham ethos of putting the student first and above all else, our medical school is small enough for our students to be part of a coherent and supportive community, and large enough to provide all the experience you need to become a medical practitioner.
Why the University of Buckingham - Crewe Campus
2-Year Bachelor's Degree: We created our two-year degrees by adding an extra term in each summer. This means you can fit in the same number of teaching weeks as a traditional three-year degree without your workload getting any bigger.

university-of-chester.name: University of Chester
university-of-chester.about:
With 15,000 students from 130 countries worldwide, The University of Chester provides a vibrant, diverse and safe home for international students.
The university is one of the oldest higher education providers in the United Kingdom having recently celebrated its 180th year of teaching, starting off as a teacher training college back in 1839. Originally based on one campus in Chester, the university now offers more than 200 single and combined honour’s programmes across a number of specialist sites in Chester, Shrewsbury and Warrington. Courses have an emphasis on practical learning to enhance prospects via industry placements or overseas opportunities, ranging from five-weeks to one-year.
Following more than 41,000 student reviews across 150 UK Universities, the University of Chester finished second in the best for international students' category at the 2020 WhatUni? Student Choice Awards. This national recognition, voted for by current international students, is testament to the university’s commitment to providing international students with the very best experience and support.
Why University of Chester - University Centre Reaseheath?
Location: Located on the outskirts of Nantwich in rural Cheshire, this campus has industry standard teaching facilities but still retains its friendly, supportive atmosphere. Set among 330 hectares of farm, parklands and woodland with its own lake, this stunning campus is the perfect environment for degree students to work, rest and play.
Facilities: The innovative £8 million National Centre for Horticulture, the Environment and Sustainable Technology is one of the most modern glasshouse training facilities in the UK with its state-of-the-art glasshouse for food crop trials and research.

university-of-chichester.name: University of Chichester
university-of-chichester.about:
The University of Chichester has a long history of higher education, having celebrated their 180th anniversary in 2019. Set across two beautiful campuses. the school has been providing education on its Bishop Otter Campus since 1839 and its Bognor Regis campus has provided teacher training since the 1940s. Today, the Bishop Otter Campus is home to the majority of the university's academic areas including Sports, Law, Humanities, Art, Theatre and Dance, as well as their highly ranked BSc (hons) Psychology programmes, currently Top 20 in the Guardian league table. Bognor Regis campus is home to other key subject areas including Business, Computing, Education and Maths, Engineering and Product Design and Creative Industry programmes.
The school is known for helping students achieve their aspirations through high-quality, personalised teaching and excellent student support - students are known by name here and not just a number. Teaching at the University of Chichester is informed and influenced by the research, professional practice, innovation, and enterprise activity undertaken by the staff. This school has a long tradition of working with international students and understands the needs of those studying away from their home countries and cultures. All programmes are designed with international students in mind and there are several programmes and academic services available especially for them.
Why University of Chichester
Campus life: Thanks to the University of Chichester's inclusive community, it has been named the 4th best UK university for student welfare and it is in the UK's top 10 for student experience.

university-of-cumbria.name: University of Cumbria
university-of-cumbria.about:
The University of Cumbria is a place of possibility, where amazing journeys happen. Where it’s safe for students to be brave, to be boldly themselves. Cumbria offers exciting research-informed academic studies, professionally focused courses and technical skills so students can achieve their future career ambitions. They enrich their students so that they can realise their potential and achieve life-changing outcomes. That's why 97% of their graduates enter employment within 6 months of graduating.
Five campuses, one Cumbria, infinite possibility. Cumbria equips, empowers and inspires students to discover great things from the day they arrive. Whatever students want to be, Cumbria offers a wide range of degrees across health, sports, social work, teaching, business, law, science, conservation, outdoor studies, arts, creativity, tourism, policing and more. The University of Cumbria, where the impossible is made possible.
Why The University of Cumbria - Ambleside Campus
National Park and UNESCO World Heritage Site: Cumbria’s unique Ambleside campus is the only UK university-based within a National Park and UNESCO World Heritage Site. This park has 214 mountains, 67,671 hectares of woodland, and is home to rare and endangered species including ospreys, red and roe deer, otters, red squirrels and atlantic salmon.
Hands On Approach: There is no better place to study the outdoors than in the heart of the Lake District. The Ambleside campus provides a unique learning environment and unrivalled academic experience. Courses at Ambleside take advantage of its unique location with a practical approach to Conservation, Forestry, Outdoor Studies, Geography, and English Literature and Creative Writing.

university-of-derby.name: University of Derby
university-of-derby.about:
The University of Derby is pushing the boundaries of knowledge to create a better, fairer, and more sustainable future for everyone. Their thriving community of researchers, professionals, and practitioners influence the creation of new knowledge by sharing their expertise. The university's students learn in state-of-the-art facilities, and the university plays a key role in the communities of Derby and Derbyshire.
Research lives in the University of Derby's classrooms. They explore, innovate, and discover solutions to the challenges facing all now and in the future - in the city, region, and across the world. The University applies this in their teaching, powering the next generation of gamechangers, nurturing talent, and helping their students to develop the skills, resilience, and curiosity they will need to make an impact.
Why University of Derby - Derby
Location: The Derby Campus is made up of several different sites. Getting between them and the halls of residence couldn't be easier. Whether students are heading to lectures or into town, they can hop on to the University's Unibuses or enjoy a walk to unwind. Derby sits in the centre of England, and it is close to the M1 and M6 motorways, as well as being within easy reach of East Midlands Airport. By train, students can get to London in 90 minutes or to Birmingham in 35 minutes.
Facilities: Kedleston Road in Derby is home to the University's fantastic Sports Centre, four-storey library, and spacious study areas. Students will also find plenty of places to eat and socialise with their friends, including Starbucks, Subway, the Union of Students' café and bar, and much more.

university-of-east-london.name: University of East London
university-of-east-london.about:
The University of East London was founded in 1898 with the aim of serving both its local community and a wider audience. The University believes that education is a potent tool in decreasing inequality and promoting a brighter future for everyone. UEL is reshaping education for the benefit of all, giving students from any background the skills and opportunities to thrive in the modern world.
The University of East London equips students for a rewarding career with work placements, networking opportunities, and tools to navigate the unexpected. Their graduates - whether artists, architects, or accountants - are making a real impact in their communities.
Why University of East London (UEL)
Location: UEL is one of the only London-based universities to have a self-contained campus. They are part of the local community and well-connected to the rest of London, and the world - City Airport is at their doorstep. Full of culture, creativity and career opportunities, East London is one of the youngest, most multicultural neighbourhoods in the UK, so students will fit in no matter where they’re from.
Careers-Led University: UEL is a careers-first university, offering education and industry access to people from all walks of life. With ambition and hard work, students can turn their goals into reality through UEL's contacts, expertise, and support. Their academics, often active in their industries, guide students through courses designed to address real-world challenges. The University collaborates with industry to constantly update its courses, ensuring that education aligns with evolving employer needs, preparing students for a rewarding career.

university-of-edinburgh.name: University of Edinburgh
university-of-edinburgh.about:
Founded by the city of Edinburgh in 1583, the University of Edinburgh was the first true civic university in the UK and one of the four ancient universities of Scotland. Join some of the best students from around the globe at one of the world's top universities. Students will invest in an education that will help them build a successful future.
Join the University of Edinburgh's 13,000-strong international student community. The University of Edinburgh's flexible programmes, world-class facilities and award-winning support services combine to ensure students' university experience is exceptional and unique. The University works to support students at all stages offering welfare support, practical advice and events.
Why The University of Edinburgh
Location: The University is at the heart of the city of Edinburgh. Scotland’s inspiring capital is one of Europe’s great cultural hubs and a stimulating place to study. Edinburgh's dynamic cultural scene boasts the largest collection of historic buildings, museums, art galleries and theaters of any city in Scotland.
Clubs and Societies: The clubs and societies will help students develop their interests, meet like-minded people, indulge a hobby or simply socialize. The University of Edinburgh's host an extensive range of clubs and societies here at Edinburgh. With more than 290 to choose from, students are bound to find one that’s right for them.
Facilities and Services: At Edinburgh, students will get generous, flexible access to a state-of-the-art library, IT resources and study spaces, helping them fit study into their busy life. Students will have access to personal support services for all of their concerns, academic or otherwise.
Sport and Exercise: Edinburgh is one of the UK’s leading sports universities.

university-of-essex.name: University of Essex
university-of-essex.about:
The University of Essex is a school where curiosity prevails, and where exploring new ways of thinking and pushing boundaries, isn’t just encouraged, it’s expected. The University of Essex was named University of the Year at the Times Higher Education Awards 2018 for their determination to do things differently and put student success at the centre of everything they do.
Essex boasts a massive 350-mile coastline, the 2nd longest of any county in England. There’s plenty to explore across the county, from countryside walks to award-winning beaches. Students can even try a plate of freshly caught oysters, or take a boat trip from Walton-on-the Naze to see the local seals! There’s lots for students to explore, and it is just a short train ride from London. This makes it great for students because they can enjoy being near the capital, but with a lower cost of living.
Join a bold and brilliant community of learning at the University of Essex, home to radical thinking and challenging ideas since the 1960s!
Why University of Essex - Colchester Campus
Gold-Rated Teaching: The University of Essex has a Gold rating in the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF). This means that the teaching quality, learning environments and student outcomes students can look forward to are among the best in the UK.
Campus: The University of Essex’s Colchester-based campus is well equipped to support each students’ studies. They will have access to a 6-floor library, IT suites and even a cinema! Other great on-campus amenities include a sports centre, hair salon, shops and restaurants. The campus is set around a tranquil lake and has lots of resident wildlife, so students can study in a beautiful natural environment.

university-of-gloucestershire.name: University of Gloucestershire
university-of-gloucestershire.about:
The University of Gloucestershire offers a wide range of degrees, courses and apprenticeships at undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Typically, students learn theory from industry experts and put their learning into practice in course work, real-world projects, placements and field trips. The school has a 150-year tradition of education dating back to 1847​. There are over 100 academic courses to choose from and approximately 10,000 students studying at the three campuses in Gloucestershire.
The City campus building will be brought back to life as a vibrant campus in the heart of the city - a modern centre for teaching, learning and community partnerships where graduates that will be trained there will go into jobs that are crucial to the future.
Why University of Gloucestershire
Campus Location: University of Gloucestershire's City campus is located right at the heart of its community, creating a vibrant hub of new activity in Kings Square. Shared public access facilities are set to include a new Health, Arts and Wellbeing Centre in partnership with the NHS Integrated Care Board, and a new public library in partnership with Gloucestershire County Council.
Cutting-edge Facilities: Facilities include simulation spaces, VR labs, an immersive reality room, and an Electroencephalogram (EEG) lab where students can learn about the naturally occurring electric activity taking place in the brain, and monitor how it is affected by various tasks, conditions and other factors. There will also be science and computer labs, art room and multi-purpose spaces for education teaching and group work.
Food and Drink: City Campus is situated on Kings Square in the heart of the city, with numerous shops, cafés and eateries within easy reach.

university-of-greenwich.name: University of Greenwich
university-of-greenwich.about:
Greenwich is more than a collection of individual students and staff, it is a community of people united by their passion for learning. University of Greenwich courses will give you the skills employers value and the confidence to achieve extraordinary things. Our historic campuses in London and Kent offer first-class facilities, inspiring teaching and a friendly, diverse community. Greenwich employs well-qualified, expert teaching staff, the majority with formal teaching qualifications. A large number of our academics have also previously worked in business or industry. You'll benefit from excellent study facilities, including first-class advanced laboratories for science and engineering subjects and three campus libraries with dedicated academic services librarians.
Why the University of Greenwich
Beautiful, inspiring locations: The iconic Greenwich Maritime World Heritage Site receives millions of tourists each year who visit the Royal Observatory meridian line, Cutty Sark ship, historic market, museums and, of course, the ORNC. The campus can be seen in many movies including Skyfall and Pirates of the Caribbean, and TV series such as The Crown.
Facilities to shape your future: Since 2013, the university has invested more than £150 million in laboratories, teaching spaces and student facilities.
Advancing knowledge at Greenwich: Research addresses some of the world's most challenging issues, from global health to public safety. Current investigations include mosquito-carried diseases, such as malaria and the Zika virus, and the use of 3D printers for medical implants. Other projects include life-saving research into evacuating difficult environments, such as high-rise construction sites, and understanding the links between politics and the economy.

university-of-hertfordshire.name: University of Hertfordshire
university-of-hertfordshire.about:
The University of Hertfordshire is the UK's leading business-facing university and an exemplar in the sector. It is innovative and enterprising and challenges individuals and organizations to excel. The University of Hertfordshire is one of the region's largest employers with over 2,700 staff and a turnover of more than £238 million. With a student community of over 25,300 including more than 2,800 international students from 100 different countries, the University has a global network of over 210,000 alumni. It continues to rise up the national rankings.
Why the University of Hertfordshire
High-Quality Education: The University is of the highest quality in the UK as it has been awarded Gold in the Teaching Excellence and Student Outcomes Framework. Over 96.5% of Herts students are employed within the first six months of graduating.
Physical Well-Being: Active Students is an excellent program designed to help students of all backgrounds stay fit and healthy on campus. There is a wide variety of classes to choose from, including Pilates, Weight Training, Smash HIIT, and so much more.
Convenient Campus and Facilities: Herts students are surrounded by culture and entertainment to suit all tastes and interests! Some of these include: Access to great music and theatre communities, restaurants on and off-campus, museums and galleries, live sporting events, and outside spaces and parks on and off-campus.

university-of-kent.name: University of Kent
university-of-kent.about:
Inspire global ambition at the University of Kent, top 40 UK university with outstanding teaching, modern facilities, award-winning student support and vibrant study locations. Over 18,000 students over 100 nations study across its two spacious UK campuses in Canterbury and Medway which are both less than one hour by train to London and close proximity to Europe.
Students who choose Kent for their undergraduate or postgraduate degree will be joining an institution known for its outstanding research, and one that can help students to meet their career goals through excellent support and quality teaching. Beyond that, students are also joining a diverse community of thinkers - critical and creative - who will spark inspiration and challenge students to question their own expertise.
Students will benefit from leading facilities, the latest technology, and a truly supportive environment including various services aimed at supporting any student concerns or obstacles to successful study. The focus of every single degree at Kent is not solely on the subject matter, but also the wider skillsets required to work in that field. As such, wherever possible, real-world experiences are woven into each degree, fully preparing students for their future role.
Students at Kent will benefit from world-class research, outstanding teaching quality and excellent careers guidance too. As well as developing skills in interviewing, finding jobs and building up a wide range of talents, students will earn Employability Points, rewarding the most pro-active students with the best opportunities for internships and more.

University of Lancashire - Burnley Campus is home to a growing community of students, who love its food scene and vibrant nightlife. There's plenty to do in Burnley, from entertainment and sport, to relaxing green spaces. Find out more about student life in Burnley.
Why University of Lancashire - Burnley
Mission: University is proud of their mission and they take it seriously. Since being founded as the Institution for the Diffusion of Knowledge in 1828, their educational ethos has brought life-changing learning to local people, this remains at the heart of their mission. University institution motto ‘Ex solo ad solem’ translates to ‘From the Earth to the Sun’. It means helping talented people from all walks of life to make the most of their potential. They create positive change in their students, staff, business partners and wider communities, enabling them to develop their full potential by providing excellent higher education, innovation and research.They are a proud civic anchor too, committed to adding social value and playing their role in the economic prosperity of the places in which they are based; sourcing products and services locally, boosting jobs and economic growth. There pride themselves on universally supporting their people, being actively liberating, inherently innovative and proudly spirited to face whatever life throws at us. These values are woven into the fabric of who they are and will always be.
Values and initiatives: University of Lancashire - Burnley values reflect who they are as a university and what they stand for. They define the things that are most important to us and nurture University's sense of shared purpose.

university-of-law.name: University of Law
university-of-law.about:
The University of Law is one of the UK's leading professional law schools, with an unrivalled reputation for innovation and excellence in legal learning. Their first-class global connections means they are uniquely placed to help aspiring lawyers, legal professionals and legal employers of all types achieve their ambitions.
What really sets the University of Law apart from other universities is their guiding principle that future lawyers and business leaders should learn in a realistic, professional and contemporary context, with plenty of practical interactive engagement. That's why they keep their contact hours high and their teaching groups small.
The University of Law's track record of excellence in learning and development has helped them establish worldwide connections within the legal and business industries. This is why many leading global law firms and businesses work exclusively with the University of Law to develop their people, and why employers of all types want to meet University of Law students. It’s why law schools and professional bodies around the world choose to enter into strategic alliances with the University of Law.
The University of Law has a vast network in the legal industry and deliver legal training to 94 of the top 100 law firms, with exclusive relationships with 60 of the top UK law firms and many of the most prestigious US firms in the UK.
The Newcastle University campus is located in the city centre, close to the high street, restaurants and parkland. It is renowned for being the business and social hub of the North East, Newcastle is a great place to study. With a large and vibrant cultural sector, and exceptional shopping and leisure facilities, there’s always something to do.

university-of-leicester.name: University of Leicester
university-of-leicester.about:
The University of Leicester was founded as Leicester, Leicestershire and Rutland University College in 1921. The site for the University was donated by a local businessman, Thomas Fielding Johnson, in order to create a living memorial for all local people who made sacrifices during the First World War. This is reflected in the University's motto, Ut vitam habeant - 'so that they may have life'.
The University offers a range of undergraduate and postgraduate courses, many with industry options. As one of the UK’s most affordable cities for students, Leicester offers outstanding value for students' future, with affordable living, excellent teaching, and generous scholarships for international students.
The University of Leicester is a leading UK university committed to international excellence through the creation of world-changing research and high-quality, inspirational teaching. Leicester is consistently one of the most socially inclusive of the UK’s leading universities, with a long-standing commitment to providing fairer and equal access to higher education.
Why the University of Leicester
Location: Leicester was named as the 9th most affordable UK city for student living in Natwest’s Student Living Index 2023. This vibrant, low-cost, and multicultural city will make students feel right at home, no matter where in the world they are coming from. Leicester is only one hour away from London by train and has great transport links to other UK cities, including Nottingham, Birmingham, Leeds, and Manchester.
Scholarships: The University of Leicester offers many competitive scholarships for its international students, including an International undergraduate tuition fee waiver, International Merit Scholarship, and Chancellor’s International Scholarship, among others.

university-of-lincoln.name: University of Lincoln
university-of-lincoln.about:
Set against the backdrop of a beautiful and historic city, the University of Lincoln sits at the heart of it all on the picturesque Brayford Pool waterfront, with almost everything students will need either on campus or just a short walk away.
Established in 1996, the university has flourished into a diverse, internationally recognised university which welcomes thousands of students each year from around the world. In November 2023, the University of Lincoln was awarded the Queen's Anniversary Prize, the UK's highest award for universities, to recognise its work supporting the agri-food sector.
Throughout this exciting period of development, the university has been guided by a consistent set of principles which remain at the heart of its approach today: excellence in teaching, learning, and quality of student experience; responsiveness to the needs of communities and organisations; and working in partnership to make great things happen.
Why University of Lincoln - Brayford Pool
Future Ready Degree Courses: University of Lincoln's degree courses are packed with features to help students develop the skills and expertise that employers are looking for. Many of their courses are accredited by recognised and respected organisations, such as the Chartered Management Institute, and include employability, professional practice, or work-based learning modules that can help students apply theory to practice.
Industry Insights: The university's Futures Programme provides opportunities to hear from inspiring guest speakers, who are invited to talk about their careers and to discuss emerging industry trends.

university-of-reading.name: University of Reading
university-of-reading.about:
The University of Reading has been at the forefront of UK higher education for nearly a century. Over the decades, they have become innovators and pioneers, pushing academic boundaries and leading social change. They want to inspire innovative and creative approaches to teaching and learning by working in partnership with staff and with the student community. Home to more than 19,000 students, the University of Reading is proud to welcome staff and students from all of the world. Their award-winning campuses house contemporary study facilities, halls of residence, support services, cafés and bars.
University of Reading strives to create a stronger, better University of Reading, building on their past to create an exceptional future. Their four guiding principles form the foundation of Reading's strategy: a genuine love of learning; creating new knowledge; embracing and celebrating diversity of people and ideas; and caring for our environment.
The University of Reading is among the top 30 UK universities in world rankings (ranked 29th out of 84 UK universities featured in the QS World University Rankings 2020) and 98% of their research is rated as being of international standing (Research Excellence Framework, 2014). As a result, the University is already a key partner for businesses of all sizes, from multinational corporations to growing, innovative SMEs.
Why University of Reading
Campus: University of Reading's main campus is set in 130 hectares of beautiful parkland, so students will find plenty of places to relax during the day. The campus has won nine consecutive Green Flag awards, recognizing it as one of Britain’s top green spaces.
Community: The University has a wide range of events and activities for students to take part in.

university-of-south-wales.name: University of South Wales
university-of-south-wales.about:
At the University of South Wales, it’s all about being bold, independent and fulfilling potential. It is one of the largest universities in the UK, offering students excellent opportunities and prospects. South Wales is an exceptional part of the UK, with city life, countryside and coast. With campuses located in Cardiff, Newport, Pontypridd and Dubai, 95% of graduates work or study within six months of graduation (DLHE 2016/17). All of these campuses are easily reached by road, rail and air, so wherever students come from, they’re never far from home.
A modern, ambitious university, the University of South Wales makes a real difference to the lives of students, staff and the communities which surround it. With campuses in Cardiff, Newport, Pontypridd and Dubai, the University is renowned for its partnerships with major employers. Their industry connections and emphasis on equipping students with real world experiences make their graduates among the most employable in the UK. And throughout everything they do, they strive to stay true to their core values of being Professional, Responsive, Inspiring and Creative.
Why The University of South Wales
Work Placements: Several courses offered at South Wales University guarantee work placements, while the Business and Management, Engineering, Computing and Science and Creative Industries faculties offer the opportunity to work in industry for a year.
Study Abroad: ERASMUS+ is the European Union programme for training, youth and sport offering exciting opportunities for participants to study, work, volunteer, teach and train abroad.
Employability: The University works hard to ensure that students are ready to start a successful career as soon as they graduate.

university-of-wales-trinity-saint-david.about:
University of Wales Trinity Saint David (UWTSD) - Birmingham is a city-centre campus offering career-focused, professionally relevant and industry-oriented education in the heart of Birmingham, United Kingdom. The campus provides students with an engaging learning environment that combines academic knowledge with practical skills and real-world applications. Located in one of the UK's most vibrant and diverse cities, the Birmingham campus offers students access to a wide range of cultural, social, business and professional opportunities. Through its focus on applied learning, academic development and employability, UWTSD Birmingham aims to prepare students for successful careers in their chosen fields while supporting their personal and professional growth.
Why University of Wales Trinity Saint David - Birmingham
Student Experience: Birmingham offers a vibrant, diverse and multicultural student environment, welcoming students from different backgrounds and cultures. Students can experience a dynamic city lifestyle while benefiting from a range of cultural, social, recreational and professional opportunities. The city's diverse communities, entertainment venues, shopping destinations and cultural attractions contribute to an engaging student experience. Its well-connected transport network also makes it convenient for students to explore the city and surrounding areas.
Birmingham Location: The campus is situated in central Birmingham, one of the United Kingdom's major metropolitan cities and a significant centre for business, finance, technology, education and culture. Its central location provides convenient access to public transportation, commercial districts, business establishments, retail centres and entertainment facilities.

university-of-west-london.name: University of West London
university-of-west-london.about:
The University of West London draws on a heritage of over 150 years in teaching and professional education. From the outset, it has played, and continues to play, a significant role in the educational, cultural, and economic life of its region. Over the years, leading academic institutions, career-focused training providers, and industry specialists have come together to shape what it is today-a university dedicated to students’ careers.
Students are taught by industry professionals with connections to global networks in their chosen fields, and many courses offer the opportunity to undertake placement years where applicable, alongside lifelong careers advice after graduation. The University offers a wide range of high-quality facilities, including an industry-standard Boeing 737 flight simulator, radio, TV and film production studios, nursing simulation centres, music recording suites, and professional kitchens. Beyond the classroom, London becomes an extended campus, offering access to world-class museums, theatres, and landmarks, and the chance to experience one of the most diverse cultural environments in the world.
Why University of West London (UWL)
London Location, Local Community: Studying at the University of West London’s West London Campus offers the best of both worlds, with a vibrant local community and beautiful parks nearby, alongside easy access to the energy of central London just a few stops away on the Tube.
Great Employment Prospects: Industry-led teaching and specialist careers advice make studying at the University of West London a strong choice for future career success. Students have opportunities to search for placements, engage with employers to gain hands-on experience, and receive tailored, lifelong careers counselling and support.

university-of-westminster.name: University of Westminster
university-of-westminster.about:
University of Westminster - a global university with London energy
Since 1838, the University of Westminster has been helping students from all backgrounds to achieve their potential. And, with over 19,000 students from 160 different countries, University of Westminster is proud to be one of the most diverse universities in the UK.
The university's courses are career-focused and often professionally accredited to give applicants practical skills and professional expertise they need for their future career.
Across four campuses, including three in central London, students will be taught in world-class teaching facilities. The university's location gives students easy access to the city's financial centre, leading international employers and an endless choice of social and cultural attractions from music, restaurants and bars to theatres, libraries and world-class museums.
Cavendish Campus is a few minutes from Oxford Street and Tottenham Court Road in the centre of London. This site houses modern computer suites, state-of-the-art science and psychology laboratories, and an extensive library. University of Westminster offer a broad range of undergraduate and postgraduate courses at this campus including:
Biological and Biomedical Sciences
Computer Science and Engineering
Data Science and Informatics
Nutrition and Public Health
Psychology
Why University of Westminster - Cavendish
Excellent Location: With three campuses in central London and a creative hub in Harrow, north-west London, you'll study in one of the most culturally rich, vibrant cities in the world, which is regularly voted one of best places to be a student according to the QS Best Student Cities Ranking.

university-of-winchester.name: University of Winchester
university-of-winchester.about:
The University of Winchester is a renowned educational institution with a 185-year history of academic excellence. It is ranked among the Top 15 for graduates in employment and/or further study (in England, Graduate Outcomes Survey 2025, HESA). The campus offers a dynamic academic environment, providing a diverse range of postgraduate and undergraduate courses. Focused on providing excellence in teaching, class sizes are small, with the aim of giving students an outstanding student experience.
Located in the historic city of Winchester, this beautiful self-contained campus boasts a welcoming, community feel, offering first-class, sustainable facilities for learning, teaching and student life. Its convenient location is within easy walking distance of Winchester city centre.
With its medieval architecture and charming streets, this quintessential English city has a rich heritage with lots to offer. Winchester offers students a safe and secure environment, ranked Top 5 safest university cities in England and Wales, Complete University Guide, 2023.
Winchester provides good transport links throughout the United Kingdom, allowing students to enjoy the convenience of direct lines to London in under one hour. The city centre is an easy walk from the University of Winchester campus, and students can explore the Great Hall with King Arthur’s Round Table, the Winchester Cathedral and other nearby attractions.
Why University of Winchester (UoW)
Location: Situated in Hampshire, South East England, the vibrant city of Winchester offers a lively contemporary culture, including a thriving arts scene, independent shops, cafes, and restaurants. This welcoming city provides a unique and enriching student experience.
